Develop ad creative concepts and variations for Meta campaigns.

Prepare different headlines, primary text, hooks, and creative angles for testing.

Coordinate simple image, video, and format variations for campaign use.

Organize creative files, versions, and testing notes.

Requirements

Good understanding of social media advertising content.

Strong written English and ability to create clear, concise ad copy.

Comfortable developing multiple variations from one core idea.

Good attention to detail when preparing creative assets.

Able to work independently within agreed creative batches and deadlines.

Experience with Canva, CapCut, or similar creative tools.

Comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools to create ad copy, headline variations, hooks, and creative ideas for testing.

Basic understanding of Meta ad formats and creative performance.



The part-time schedule can be arranged around creative production batches, campaign testing periods, and agreed workloads. The role directly contributes to the creative testing pipeline and campaign performance.



Training and feedback will be provided to help you understand our creative standards and testing process.

title: Social Media & Brand Communications Strategist
description:
We're looking for an experienced Social Media & Brand Communications Strategist to join our growing virtual team of 15 VAs. This is a long-term role with strong potential for full-time employment.



You'll work directly with clients in Canada, the U.S., and Europe managing their social media from strategy through execution, plus some general virtual assistant support. The role starts at 10 hours/week and grows to 30–40 hours/week as you take on more clients (2–4 at a time).



This is not a basic content-scheduling role. We want someone who takes ownership, thinks ahead, builds systems, and helps clients strengthen their brands through meaningful storytelling.



What You'll Do

Social Media Strategy

• Develop monthly content calendars and platform-specific strategies for Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok

• Identify campaigns, themes, and content series

• Research trends, review analytics, and recommend ideas that grow visibility and engagement



Content Creation

• Turn raw notes, photos, and videos into engaging, platform-tailored content

• Write compelling captions and design Canva graphics and carousels

• Edit short-form videos and reels, and repurpose content into multiple formats



Storytelling & Communications

Go beyond "posting content." You'll spot the stories worth telling client wins, community impact, testimonials, behind-the-scenes moments, event highlights, and partner recognition. Every post should communicate purpose, not just report what happened.



Community & Publishing

• Schedule and publish content, tagging partners and sponsors correctly

• Monitor comments and engagement, and maintain consistency across platforms

• Follow accessibility and publishing best practices; track analytics and suggest improvements



Systems & Organization

Proactively build the systems that make everything run smoothly content-collection checklists, event forms, reusable templates, workflows, and asset libraries. You'll anticipate what's needed before content creation begins, rather than waiting for direction.



Ideal Candidate

• Proven experience managing social media across multiple platforms for businesses or organizations

• Excellent English writing and strong storytelling ability

• Canva design and short-form video editing skills

• Experience with social media scheduling tools

• Strong organization and confidence managing multiple brands

• A proactive, independent problem-solver who works well with minimal supervision



Bonus: experience with nonprofits, education, youth or Indigenous communities, coaches, or social-impact businesses.



This Role Is NOT for You If…

• You only know how to schedule posts

• You wait to be told exactly what to do

• You struggle with deadlines or don't enjoy writing

• You dislike organizing information and building systems

• You're uncomfortable communicating directly with clients

• You've never worked as a social media manager or with international clients



About Us

I've been in business for 15 years as a coach, trainer, speaker, author, podcaster, and VA specialist. I run a boutique virtual assistant agency that matches you with western clients (10 hours minimum per client, up to four). I've worked with my two main VAs for over five years and the rest of my team of 12 for one to three-and-a-half years. It's a positive, supportive environment, and training is provided as needed by both us and the clients.



Compensation

• Paid weekly, every Monday (guaranteed we don't miss paydays)

• Performance-based pay increases

• Potential 13th-month pay



How to Apply

1. Complete this Google Form: 

2.
 
 with the subject line: "August 2026 Social Media  & Brand Communications Strategist #VAJOB application has been submitted." In your first paragraph, tell me why you want this job.

3. Include a brief intro about your experience with multi-platform social media.

4. Attach your portfolio or 3–5 sample posts, reels, or IG Stories you've created (ideally across different platforms), with captions.



I'll respond within a few days from 
 so keep an eye on your inbox. This is an ongoing position, I want to bring you on for years, not weeks.



Thank you,

Diane

**Part-Time | Long-Term Position | UK Company | $8 USD per hour**



We are an established and growing commercial cleaning company based in the UK looking for a talented **Google Ads/PPC Specialist who also has strong WordPress web design and landing page skills**.



We are looking for someone to work with us long-term, rather than someone completing a single project.



## IMPORTANT – THE WEBSITE COMES FIRST



Although Google Ads will become a major part of this role, **we do not want to start spending money on advertising until our website and landing pages are ready to convert visitors into enquiries.**



Your first project will therefore be improving and developing our existing WordPress website.



Once we are happy with the website, you will then take responsibility for launching and managing our Google Ads campaigns.



## Phase 1 – Website & Landing Pages



Initially, your main responsibility will be improving our existing WordPress website.



We want you to:



* Improve the overall look and professionalism of the website

* Improve the homepage and key service pages

* Create dedicated commercial cleaning and office cleaning pages

* Create high-converting landing pages for future Google Ads campaigns

* Improve calls-to-action and enquiry forms

* Make sure the website works extremely well on mobile

* Improve page speed and user experience

* Add new written content, images and videos supplied by us

* Present our reviews, guarantees, accreditations and service benefits effectively

* Make the website focused on **generating qualified business enquiries**, not simply looking attractive

* Install and correctly configure analytics and conversion tracking ready for advertising



We already have a clear understanding of our target customers, competitors, key messages and what differentiates our company.



We need someone who can help turn this into a professional, conversion-focused website.



## Phase 2 – Google Ads / PPC



Once the website and landing pages are ready, you will take responsibility for our Google Ads campaigns.



This will include:



* Keyword and competitor research

* Google Search campaign creation

* Ad copywriting and testing

* Geographic targeting

* Negative keyword management

* Bid and budget management

* GA4 and Google Tag Manager

* Conversion tracking

* Form and telephone enquiry tracking

* Landing page testing

* Regular campaign optimisation

* Monitoring cost per qualified lead

* Simple performance reporting

* Ongoing improvements to the website and landing pages based on campaign results



Our objective is **not clicks, impressions or website traffic**.



Our objective is to generate **qualified enquiries from UK businesses looking for ongoing commercial cleaning contracts.**



## Essential Skills & Experience



You must have:



* **Strong Google Ads/PPC experience**

* **Proven lead-generation experience**

* **Previous experience working with UK businesses**

* **WordPress experience**

* **Strong web and landing page design skills**

* **Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) knowledge**

* **SEO knowledge**

* **Google Analytics 4 (GA4) experience**

* **Google Tag Manager experience**

* **Conversion tracking experience**

* **Good written and spoken English**

* **Ability to work independently and make recommendations rather than simply waiting for instructions**



## Desirable Skills



It would also be useful if you have:



* Elementor experience

* B2B lead-generation experience

* Local/service business PPC experience

* Graphic design skills

* Ability to add and optimise video content for websites

* Experience working with ongoing service/contract businesses



You do **not** need to be a professional video editor. We can provide finished or semi-finished video content for you to add to the website.



## Internet & Equipment Requirements



As this is a fully remote position, you must have:



* Your own reliable computer suitable for the work

* A **fast and stable internet connection**

* Reliable access to video calls with UK management

* A suitable backup internet option in case your main connection goes down

* The ability to upload and download website assets and video files without significant problems



We will ask shortlisted applicants to provide evidence of their current internet speed.



## Hours & Pay



### Initial Website Phase



Approximately **15–20 hours per week** while the website, landing pages, analytics and advertising infrastructure are being developed.



### Ongoing Role



Once the website is complete and Google Ads is running, we expect approximately **10 hours per week**.



These hours will be used for:



* Google Ads management and optimisation

* Monitoring campaign performance

* Landing page testing and improvements

* Website updates

* SEO improvements

* Creating additional landing/service/location pages where appropriate

* Reporting and recommendations



### Pay



**$6 USD per hour**



This is intended to be a **long-term position** for the right person.



## Before You Apply – Please Answer These Two Questions



We are looking for people who have read and understood the full job description.



**Applications that do not answer BOTH of the following questions will not be considered.**



### **1. WHAT IS THE MOST SUCCESSFUL GOOGLE PPC CAMPAIGN THAT YOU HAVE RUN?**



Please explain what the campaign was, what type of business it was for, what you personally did, how much was spent and what results you achieved.



Where possible, include **the number of leads/conversions generated and the cost per lead/conversion**.



### **2. WHAT IS YOUR FAVOURITE LANDING PAGE THAT YOU HAVE EVER DESIGNED, AND WHY?**



Please provide a **link or example of the landing page**.



Tell us what you personally designed or built, what the objective of the page was and **why you believe it was successful at converting visitors into enquiries or customers**.



## About Us



We are **Evolve Commercial Cleaning**, a growing commercial cleaning company based in North West England.



We provide ongoing contract cleaning to businesses and organisations and are now investing significantly in our website, marketing and lead generation.



Our aim is not simply to generate more website traffic. We want to build a strong online lead-generation system that consistently attracts businesses looking for high-quality commercial cleaning services.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a **long-term part of our marketing team** and help us develop and improve that system over time.

title: Google Ads Search Specialist - Local Lead Generation
description:
30-Day Paid Trial | Brisbane Australia 



TintGard is looking for a Google Ads Search specialist with proven experience generating high-intent leads for local service businesses.



This is a focused 30-day paid trial.



One market. Four weeks to demonstrate what you can do.



Perform well and there is an opportunity for ongoing management with revised compensation as we scale.



THE OBJECTIVE



Generate qualified window-tinting enquiries across Brisbane at a commercially viable cost.



Window tinting. No automotive.



Heat reduction is the biggest customer problem we solve.



Your job is to determine how customers are actually searching for our services and capture the highest-intent, commercially valuable searches.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITY



You will take ownership of the Google Search campaign, including:



* Keyword and search-intent research

* Campaign/ad-group structure

* Match types

* Negative keywords

* Brisbane-wide targeting

* Ad copy

* Assets/extensions

* Bidding

* Budget allocation

* Conversion tracking

* Search-term analysis

* Wasted-spend reduction

* Testing

* Ongoing optimisation



We want people genuinely looking for professional window tinting.



We don’t want traffic for the sake of traffic.



LANDING PAGE & CONVERSION



You are responsible for creating and launching the conversion-focused landing page required for the campaign.



This does not need to be a complex website development project.



It needs to be a simple, fast, mobile-friendly landing page designed to convert high-intent Google Search traffic into calls and enquiries.



You are responsible for:



* Landing-page structure

* Headline and messaging

* Copy

* CTA

* Form

* Click-to-call

* Trust/social proof

* Mobile experience

* Conversion tracking

* Basic CRO and optimisation during the trial



TintGard will provide the required branding, genuine project photos, reviews and business information.



The landing page must be ready for the campaign to launch.



SEARCH - AD - LANDING PAGE - ENQUIRY



You own the paid customer journey from the search through to the enquiry.



30 DAYS OF ACTIVE MANAGEMENT



This is not a setup-and-disappear job.



The campaign needs active attention throughout the trial.



BUILD - LAUNCH - WATCH - LEARN - ADJUST - REPEAT



You will:



* Monitor actual search terms

* Add negative keywords quickly

* Identify wasted spend

* Remove irrelevant traffic

* Monitor lead quality

* Test ads

* Adjust keywords and match types

* Optimise bids and budget

* Verify conversion tracking

* Improve landing-page conversion

* Move spend toward what produces genuine opportunities



DAILY COLLABORATION



There are only four weeks, so we will collaborate every business day as required.



I don’t want to wait until the end of the week to discover money has been wasted or an opportunity has been missed.



This does not mean long daily meetings or reports.



It means you are actively checking the campaign and we communicate quickly when something needs attention.



I will provide direct feedback on:



LEAD QUALITY - QUOTES - JOBS



so you can optimise against actual business outcomes rather than Google Ads numbers alone.



THE SCOREBOARD



Clicks, impressions and CTR are useful diagnostic information.



They are not success.



AD SPEND - QUALIFIED LEADS - QUOTES - JOBS - REVENUE



We will monitor:



* Ad spend

* Leads

* Qualified leads

* Cost per lead

* Cost per qualified lead

* Quotes

* Jobs won

* Customer acquisition cost

* Revenue generated



A qualified lead means a genuine prospective Brisbane customer seeking professional window tinting.



OWNERSHIP



TintGard owns and controls:



* Google Ads account

* Billing

* Campaigns

* Landing page

* Conversion tracking

* Campaign data

* Campaign assets



Advertising spend is paid directly by TintGard to Google.



30-DAY PAID TRIAL



Fixed payment: $250 AUD



This is the trial rate, not the proposed long-term management rate.



The purpose of the first 30 days is to demonstrate your capability and establish whether we work well together.



Produce commercially viable results and there is an opportunity for:



ONGOING MANAGEMENT + REVISED COMPENSATION + INCREASED AD SPEND



If you can make the advertising profitable, we want to scale it.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You should already know how to manage:



* Google Search Ads

* High-intent local lead generation

* Search intent

* Keyword research

* Match types

* Negative keywords

* Search-term optimisation

* Conversion tracking

* Landing-page CRO

* Bidding

* Budget optimisation



Experience generating leads for home services, trades or other local service businesses is highly desirable.



I am not looking for someone to learn Google Ads on my account.



HOW TO APPLY



Keep your application short and specific.



1. Show me 2–3 Google Search campaigns you personally managed for local service businesses.



Where possible show:



Spend - Leads - CPL - Customers



2. What did you personally do on those accounts?



3. Show me a paid-search landing page you personally built.



4. How many Google Ads accounts are you personally managing right now?



5. During the first month of a new campaign, how frequently do you review actual search terms?



6. In a few sentences, explain how you identify and eliminate wasted Google Search spend.



7. Can you collaborate with me throughout the four-week trial and respond quickly when campaign decisions need to be made?



IMPORTANT



Start your application with:



HIGH INTENT ONLY



Generic applications, copy-and-paste proposals and agency packages will not be considered.



I don’t need a long proposal.



I want evidence that you know how to do this.



30 DAYS | $250 AUD | BRISBANE



WINDOW TINTING — NO AUTOMOTIVE



GOOGLE SEARCH - QUALIFIED LEADS - JOBS



Prove yourself over 30 days and we’ll build from there.

title: Social & Community Manager (Part-Time, 2 Days/Week) - US Audience
description:
IMPORTANT: this is not a VA or admin job. If that's the work you're after, please skip this one.



We're a European startup. Our habit app is built on behavioural science and it launches in the US this December. Right now our US accounts don't exist at all: no TikTok, no Instagram, no X, no Shorts, no newsletter. You'd be the one starting them.



WHAT YOU'D DO

- Turn approved ideas into finished posts: carousels, quote cards, short-form video edits, story graphics

- Schedule and publish across Instagram, TikTok and Shorts

- Handle the community: replies, DMs, comments, polls, question boxes

- Run the newsletter: welcome and weekly sends, the list, the open rates

- Tell us each week what worked. That d
 what we make next



WHAT YOU NEED

- Either 2+ years in social media or content production, or a page of your own that you grew past 10,000 followers

- That audience should have been in the US. We don't mind where you live, we mind who was watching

- You can edit short-form video yourself (CapCut or anything similar)

- You can make clean graphics from an existing design system (Canva or similar)

- Genuinely fluent English, written and spoken, because you'll be writing publicly in our voice



NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED

Animation or motion design on video. We may never ask for it. It's a real plus if you have it.



HOW IT WORKS

Our Head of Creative owns the strategy and the brand voice. You work out how it lands on each platform. It's mostly execution at the start, and your say grows as you get to know the audience.



WHAT WE COVER

- Every tool and subscription you need

- Bank transfer, and the transfer fees are ours

- Remote, and you arrange your own hours

- The occasional call with a UK-based colleague



WHEN YOU APPLY, SEND

1. A link to an account you grew, the follower count when you started and when you stopped, and where that audience was

2. One short-form video you edited yourself

3. Your CV or portfolio



If there's no video link we won't review it. We get a lot of applications.

title: Client Experience Specialist for UHNW Clients
description:
We're searching for a lifestyle manager to join our member experience team. You'll communicate with members, anticipate their needs, and coordinate all the logistics to deliver a world-class experience.



Please note: this job isn't for everyone. We expect an extremely high standard of work from everyone in our team, and reward that work accordingly.



About us:

We're an AI-enabled lifestyle curation startup, serving a private community of ultra high net-worth members around the globe. We proactively curate and deliver on-demand luxury dining, travel, entertainment, and wellness experiences to our members.



What we're looking for:



* You're ambitious and competitive, and you work with a sense of urgency

* You're relentlessly resourceful. When someone says no, that's the start of the conversation, not the end of it

* You have taste. You know what a wealthy, well-travelled person would actually want, and what they'd find ordinary

* Near-native spoken and written English

* Very comfortable using AI tools like Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini

* 3+ years serving wealthy, demanding, or high-profile clients - luxury hospitality, concierge, travel, executive support across multiple principals, or client and account management





Comp and benefits:



* $1,400 - $2,000 per month

* PTO + public holidays



One honest warning: the queue never empties. If you measure a good day by finishing everything on your list, this will frustrate you. And if the last few years have been calendar, inbox, and expenses for one principal, this is a different kind of work. We're looking for people who have curated experiences, not administered them.

???? **Top-paid position for the right candidate.**

title: Video Editor
description:
Only applications submitted through our careers website will be considered: 



Overview


 offers a dynamic, subscription-based video editing service. We’re continuously on the hunt for creative and experienced Video Editors to join our remote team full-time (40 hours/week).

This position requires a professional with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience, either in an agency setting or managing your own clients.

The role demands versatility in creating various video types, from social content and paid ads to training videos for content creators, influencers, agencies, scale-ups, and corporates.

Keep in mind that a trial edit as well as an online assessment are part of the application process.



Requirements:

- At least 3 years of professional video editing experience. You know what it takes to create engaging video content that drives viewer engagement and increases CTR or WTT.

- Skilled in producing diverse video formats. Please detail your experience with different video types in your cover letter.

- Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, and an eye for creating engaging content.

- Fluent English, both written and spoken, with strong interpersonal skills.

- Time-efficient, goal-driven, responsive to feedback, and passionate about video editing.

- Willingness to work from in CET timezone. Though we offer flexible work hours we require our team to work between 8am and 10pm CET



Responsibilities

- Daily Collaboration: Regularly engage with Customers, Team Coordinators, Quality Specialists, and other Creatives.

Client Interaction: Interact directly with Clipmasters’ customers to understand their unique video editing needs, address concerns, and communicate effectively about their queue and overall process.

- Video Editing and Creation: Collaborate closely with Team Coordinators and Quality Specialists to ensure design quality and adherence to brand guidelines. Work closely with the production team to create engaging video content for various platforms, including social media, websites, and other digital channels.

- Asset Management: Manage and organize digital assets such as video and audio files, project files, and graphics for seamless workflow.

- Quality Optimization: Edit raw footage into polished, high-quality videos that align with brand guidelines and effectively convey the desired message. Continuously evaluate and refine the video production process to optimize efficiency and quality.

- Skill Enhancement: Stay up-to-date with the latest video editing software and techniques to ensure the highest quality output.

- Client-Centric Flexibility: Adapt to additional service requirements as specified by the client, ensuring tailored and effective video editing output.



Apply for this Job

 about the next steps. If you haven’t received anything from us by then, please check your spam folder.

title: People & Talent Lead
description:
Please Apply on our website: 



OVERVIEW

At Clipmasters, people are the product.



We’re a fast-growing, remote-first creative production company working with editors, designers, motion creatives, marketers, and operational tea
mbers across multiple countries and cultures. As we scale, we’re looking for a People & Talent Lead who will take ownership of how we hire, onboard, support, and grow our team.



This is a foundational role. You’ll be our first dedicated people hire and will work closely with the founders and our in-house trainer to shape the people side of Clipmasters with intention, clarity, and care — while keeping a high bar for quality and professionalism.



WHAT THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTISE



You’ll step into a company where a lot is already in motion. We’ve built hiring pipelines and systems that work — your job is to run them well, improve them where needed, and build the internal people structure that supports long-term growth.



You’ll be close to the team. Through regular 1:1s and check-ins, you’ll notice patterns, spot issues early, and help people grow in a way that’s good for them and for the company. You’ll also be comfortable speaking up when something isn’t working and proposing better ways forward.



REQUIREMENTS:

title: Outbound Sales Development Representative/Appointment Setter (Freelance)
description:
Clipmasters runs a video editing and design subscription for agencies and content businesses. We're looking for a sharp, self-driven outbound sales development representative to own our appointment-setting process from day one. Ideally, this is someone who can, relatively quickly, take on running sales calls and closing deals as well, and who has the capability to eventually own our whole sales process and help manage the sales team as we build it out.



If the first two months go well, this can turn into a long-term role with real room to grow into sales leadership.



The Role



You'll start by owning the entire outbound process, end to end: building targeted lists, running cold outreach, and booking qualified calls for our CEO/founder. You won't be starting from scratch: we hand you a proven playbook with sequences, scripts, and objection handling built from the outreach that signed our current clients.



If you prove yourself, there's an opportunity to move into running the sales calls yourself and closing deals, and for the right person, into owning our sales process and helping manage the sales team longer term.



What You'll Do



- Build and maintain targeted lists of video production companies, videographers, and creative agencies in our target markets, using ICP and targeting criteria we provide.

- Run cold
 sequences, LinkedIn outreach, IG DM campaigns, and cold calls, bringing your own tools and ideas on how to structure the process.

- Turn positive replies into booked calls with our CEO/founder. A call only counts as qualified if the prospect is a decision maker, has already seen our work, and already knows our pricing going in.

- Handle confirmations, reminders, and rebooking no-shows, since a booked call that doesn't happen doesn't count.

- Down the line: run sales calls, close deals, and potentially help manage the sales team as we build it out.



What We're Looking For



- You do the work yourself. No agencies, no teams, no delegating to juniors.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be writing to prospects in our name, and agency owners notice templated writing immediately.

- A track record of booking B2B meetings, ideally for agencies or service businesses, with real numbers to back it up.

- Bonus: experience running sales calls, closing deals, or leading a small sales team.

- Flexibility to work across time zones for calls and same-day reply handling, including Australia.

- Comfortable reporting weekly on contacts, replies, bookings, and show rate.

- Genuine ambition to grow into a sales leadership role.



What We Offer



- A proven playbook, scripts, case studies, and a full asset library for follow-ups

- Pricing you're allowed to share openly with prospects

- Freedom to run your own stack and methods

- Fast, direct feedback from the CEO/founder

- Hourly rate plus a bonus for every qualified call booked

- A long-term role if the first two months go well, with real room to grow into sales leadership



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions to be considered for this position:



- Tell us about one outbound campaign you personally ran end to end: how you built the list, which channels you used, the volume, the reply rate, and how many meetings it booked. Start your answer with the word "overnight" so we know you read this.

- Tell us about any experience you have running sales calls, closing deals, or leading a small sales team. If you don't have this yet, say so honestly and tell us why you're confident you could grow into it.

- Write a three-sentence cold
 you'd send to the owner of a busy video production company, introducing our service (check out 
 first). No AI-generated filler; we can tell.

- Confirm that you personally, not a team, will be doing this work, plus your time zone and realistic weekly availability.

- Which tools would you use for list building, sending, and tracking, and how would you structure your first 30 days with us?



Applications that skip these are declined without reading.

title: Guest Communications Specialist STR / Airbnb Operations - MUST have Short-Term Rental experience - Fixed UK Shift
description:
Operations Virtual Assistant - Short-Term Rental (Remote, UK Hours)



Hours: Full-time, 5 days a week, fixed shift: Friday to Tuesday, 8:00am to 4:00pm UK time (Sunday is a working day and is non-negotiable) · $4.00/hour, reviewed increase at three months tied to performance · Philippines-based, remote



DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT DIRECT SHORT-TERM RENTAL / AIRBNB EXPERIENCE.



Applications without STR experience will not be reviewed.



ABOUT US



Higgihaus runs a portfolio of aparthotels across Bristol and Cardiff in the UK. We have spent seven years building an operation that runs on tight systems, good data, and a small team that trusts each other. We are not a giant call centre and we never will be. We are a lean operations team that takes guest experience and operational quality seriously.



You would be joining our remote operations team, working alongside our existing operations VA on the evening shift, with a daily overlap hour for handover and team connection. You will be trained directly by the founder and supported as you find your feet. This is a genuine team, not a set of people who only ever clock on when someone else clocks off.



THE ROLE



This is a front-line guest operations role at its core. Your main job is to deliver brilliant, responsive guest communications and keep the operation running smoothly across your morning shift. Much of our routine guest messaging is already handled by automation, so this is not a high-volume copy-paste job. It is about handling the situations that need a real person: judgement calls, live problems during a guest's stay, escalations, the occasional phone call, and keeping guests happy when things do not go to plan.



You need to be a genuinely good communicator. Warm, clear, calm under pressure. That part is non-negotiable because it is the heart of the job.



Your morning shift is our quieter one. You will often be the only person online for the start of the shift. That means real responsibility from early on, and it means we need someone who can make a sensible call and explain their reasoning afterwards, rather than someone waiting to be told what to do.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own guest communications across your shift: enquiries, in-stay issues, escalations from our AI comms system

- Handle live operational problems: lockouts, cleaning issues, maintenance coordination with our UK team

- Take the occasional guest phone call in clear, confident English

- Monitor and action the daily operations picture: arrivals, departures, flags from our automated reports

- Keep our systems accurate: Hostaway, Airtable records, task tracking

- Spot recurring problems and raise them with the fix, not just the complaint



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

title: Ecommerce Order Fulfillment & Tracking Virtual Assistant
description:
We are a growing ecommerce company looking for a reliable and highly detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to manage daily order fulfillment and tracking.



This is a straightforward but very important role. The work is repetitive and process-driven, so we are looking for someone who is organized, accurate, dependable, and comfortable handling a high volume of orders every day.



Main Responsibilities

Fulfill customer orders manually through AliExpress.

Carefully copy and verify customer names, shipping addresses, product variants, sizes, colors, and quantities.

Make sure the correct product and variant are ordered every time.

Record AliExpress order numbers and order information in our tracking/order sheet.

Monitor fulfilled orders for tracking numbers.

Upload tracking information into Shopify when available.

Update our internal order spreadsheet with fulfillment and tracking status.

Check orders that have not received tracking updates.

Identify and flag unusual situations such as:

Product out of stock

Price changes

Seller delays

Invalid customer addresses

Failed or unusual tracking

Wrong product/variant concerns

Orders that have not shipped within the expected timeframe

Contact management when an order requires a decision or escalation.

Keep the fulfillment system organized and completely up to date.

What We Are Looking For



The most important qualities for this position are:



Extremely strong attention to detail.

Ability to perform repetitive work accurately for several hours.

Reliable attendance and communication.

Comfortable using Shopify, AliExpress, Google Sheets, and browser-based tools.

Able to follow written SOPs exactly.

Good written English.

Strong organization skills.

Ability to recognize when something looks incorrect instead of blindly processing an order.

Comfortable handling potentially 80–150+ orders per day as the company grows.



Previous Shopify, AliExpress, dropshipping, ecommerce fulfillment, or order-processing experience is preferred but not required if you are a fast learner.



Important



Accuracy is more important than speed.



Ordering the wrong size, color, quantity, product, or shipping to an incorrect address can create significant losses for the company.



You will be expected to double-check every order before submitting it.



As you become experienced with our system, we will also expect you to become faster while maintaining a very low error rate.



Schedule



This is intended to become a long-term position.



We are looking for someone who can work consistently each week and process the daily fulfillment workload without allowing orders to build up.



Additional hours may become available as order volume increases.



Compensation



Starting compensation will be discussed based on experience.



There will be opportunities for increased pay and responsibility for someone who proves to be highly reliable, accurate, and capable of managing our fulfillment operation.



Application Instructions



Please include the following in your application:



Your previous experience with Shopify, AliExpress, ecommerce, order fulfillment, or data entry.

How many hours per week you are available.

Your desired hourly rate.

Your current internet speed and whether you have backup internet access.

Tell us about a previous job where accuracy and attention to detail were important.

Include the word FULFILLMENT at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job description.



Selected applicants will be given a paid test task before being hired.

title: Facebook Ads D2C Video Editor
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products in the health and wellness niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UG-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



— WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING —



You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- AI voiceover ads: A simple combination of voiceover and b-rolls, chosen carefully and enhanced with copy, graphic and sound effects, zooms, transitions, etc.

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around

education and direct-response structure

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



— WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR —



We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals.

We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to edit videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes... then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.



— THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE —



You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



— SKILLS & EXPERIENCE —



Ideally, you have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- ??Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with in the health and wellness niche.



— WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY —



- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



— WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU —



- Competitive compensation based on experience

- Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively



How to Apply:

We will review all submissions and contact the shortlisted candidates via

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

title: Supply Chain Associate
description:
About Us

Hakkawise is a multi-brand consumer goods group. We acquire and grow a portfolio of consumer brands that sell across E-Commerce and B2B wholesale. Inventory is the lifeblood of the business — getting the right stock, in the right place, at the right time. 



The Role

We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate to work on day-to-day inventory management, forecasting, orders and supplier coordination across our brands. You'll turn sales data into reliable stock forecasts, keep suppliers on track, and build the tools that give the wider team a clear, live picture of our supply chain. This is a hands-on, analytical role.



What You'll Do

• Monitor inventory sell-through: across brands and sales channels (Amazon FBA, D2C, wholesale), spotting risks of stockouts and overstock early.

• Forecast stock requirements: translating demand trends, seasonality, and lead times into clear replenishment plans.

title: n8n Automation Developer — Automated Video Rendering Pipeline (FFmpeg)
description:
We produce long-form videos at volume. Right now the assembly is manual and it's the bottleneck.



We want an n8n workflow that renders finished videos end-to-end, unattended. You give it a topic or a row in a sheet, it comes back with a finished MP4.



The pipeline needs to:



1. Take a job in — from a Google Sheet row



2. Source footage — from two places:

- a local stock footage library (Drive folder)

- free stock APIs as fallback when the local library has no match (Pexels and Pixabay, both free for commercial use)



3. Select and sequence clips to match the script or keyword list, trim them to the right durations.



4. Composite an overlay clip on top — this is the important part. We have a branded overlay video that plays over the whole render. It has regions that are green screen/transparent, and the stock footage shows through those windows. The overlay changes at points during the video, so the pipeline has to handle multiple overlay segments in one render, not just one static layer.



5. Encode and output the final MP4 to Google Drive



6. Log and recover — every run logged, failures retried, no silent failures, no half-rendered files left behind.



Reference example of the output we want: 



Must have

- Self-hosted n8n — you've installed it yourself on a VPS or Docker, not just used the cloud UI

- FFmpeg from the command line — real fluency, specifically overlay, chromakey/colorkey, scale, concat, filter_complex. If you have only ever used a drag-and-drop editor, this role is not for you

- Execute Command / Code nodes in n8n — comfortable shelling out and handling stdout, exit codes, and file paths

- REST API integration — auth headers, pagination, rate limits, retries, caching

- Linux + SSH, file system handling, cron/queue basics

- Written English good enough to document what you built so someone else can maintain it



Nice to have

Chroma keying experience — knowing why despill and edge feathering matter

Alpha-channel video formats (ProRes 4444, VP9/WebM with alpha)

Hardware-accelerated encoding (NVENC / VAAPI / QSV)

Queue systems for long-running jobs (Redis, BullMQ, or n8n queue mode)

Prior work building unattended render pipelines at volume



Deliverables

Working n8n workflow, exported as JSON

All FFmpeg commands and helper scripts, commented

Setup documentation — how to install it fresh on a new machine

A short Loom walkthrough of how it works and how to change it

Handover

title: Outreach VA: Research & Build Relationships for Housing Provider
description:
About us

SoCal Community Homes is a supportive housing provider in Riverside County, California. We operate furnished shared homes for veterans, seniors, adults on SSI or SSDI, and people reentering the community after incarceration. We are small, we are growing, and we treat the people who work with us as part of the team.



About the role

We are building a network of referral partners: case managers, social workers, housing navigators, and program supervisors at county agencies, veteran organizations, shelters, reentry programs, and nonprofits across Riverside County. These are the professionals who place clients into housing. When they know us, they call us.



You will do both halves of this work. First you find these people. Then you reach out, introduce us, and build enough trust that they agree to a 30 minute meeting.



This is not sales. There is no product, no price, no close. Their hardest problem is finding a safe, available bed for a client who is ready to move. We have beds. That is the whole conversation, and most of them will be glad you called.



Research:

Build a verified contact list of 200 referral partners across Riverside County. For each one: full name, job title, organization, direct
, direct phone, city, and organization type. Named individuals only. General info inboxes and switchboard numbers do not count. Spread contacts across organizations rather than concentrating on any single agency. A list of cities will be provided



Outreach:

Send personalized introduction
s using our templates. Make friendly follow up calls to confirm you have the right person and invite them to a meeting. Book confirmed meetings on our calendar and send reminders. Log every call,
, and outcome in a shared tracker. Follow up on a set schedule so nothing goes cold. Keep relationships warm with periodic check ins on bed availability. Continue adding new contacts to the list as you discover them.



What success looks like

In your first XX days: a clean verified contact list, consistent weekly outreach across it, a steady flow of booked meetings, and a handful of agencies who recognize our name and reply when you write. We will set weekly targets together after training.



What we need

Excellent spoken English with a clear, warm, unscripted phone presence. You will speak with government employees and licensed social workers, so patience and clarity matter far more than speed.



Error free written English that does not read like a mass template.

Strong online research skills. You should be comfortable digging through organization websites, staff directories, LinkedIn, and public county listings to find a named person and a direct line rather than settling for a general contact form.



At least one year in appointment setting, B2B outreach, lead research, client relations, intake, or similar work. Experience with US organizations is strongly preferred.



Headset, computer, quiet workspace, reliable internet, comfort with Google Sheets, Gmail, and Calendar.



Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement. You will handle professional contact information only, never resident information.



Terms

This is a long term role and we expect hours to grow as the network grows. Keeping other clients is fine as long as your calling blocks are protected.



How to apply

Subject line: Outreach VA + [your city] + VILLAGE



Answer in your own words: Describe a time you contacted an organization and had to find the right person to speak with. What did you actually say? And why would a social worker want to hear from a housing provider? Do you have any suggestions for the implementation or strategy? Can you list a few past projects that are very similar to this project? What challenges do you see in this project?

title: DTC Creative Strategist
description:
We operate a fast-growing portfolio of digitally native consumer brands: our flagship brand Zoyava, in health and wellness supplements, and our sister brands in skincare and hair oils. We sell across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, DTC, and nationwide retail, with a steady pipeline of new product launches across all four brands. Our dedication to unparalleled quality and exceptional customer experience drives our operations, and we believe every employee's contribution is indispensable to our success.



Why This Role Exists



Paid social creative is the single biggest lever in scaling our products. Every new product we launch has one target: $1 million per month in revenue. We are hiring the person who owns the creative engine that gets each launch there. You will drive growth across all four brands and every new product in the pipeline — turning customer data, reviews, and market research into a relentless weekly stream of high-converting ad concepts across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube. You will not be the editor or the media buyer, but you will own the strategy that connects them: identifying winning angles, writing sharp briefs, directing creators and editors, and reading performance data to d
 what to scale, kill, or iterate.



What Success Looks Like in 12 Months



Every new product launch across Zoyava and our family of brands, ships with a full creative testing system from day one, and is on a measurable trajectory toward $1M/month.

Creative win rate (ads that beat account-average CPA/ROAS) improves quarter over quarter, with learnings documented in a living angle/hook library per brand and per product.

The creative pipeline never runs dry: media buyers across all four brands always have fresh, on-brand creative to test and scale.

Winning concepts are directly attributable to revenue, because your compensation depends on it.

Weekly Output Expectations

This is a high-volume, high-velocity role covering a four-brand portfolio, prioritized by the new product launch calendar. 



Steady-state expectations:



15–20 net-new ad concepts per week across the portfolio, weighted toward active and upcoming product launches, each grounded in a specific angle, audience insight, hook, and offer.

40–60 launched creative variations per week shipped through editors and UGC creators — new concepts plus iterations of proven winners.

12–15 detailed creative briefs per week for video editors, UGC creators, and designers, with hooks, scripts/outlines, references, and success criteria.

Launch sprints for every new product: a dedicated 20+ concept testing wave in the first 30 days of each launch to find scalable winners fast.

1 weekly creative performance review per brand: what won, what lost, why, and what the next testing sprint looks like.

24–48 hour feedback turnaround on all drafts to keep the production pipeline moving.



Key Responsibilities: 



Creative Strategy & Concepting

Own paid social creative strategy for all four brands — across Meta, TikTok, Snap, YouTube, and other DTC channels.

Own the creative side of every new product launch: positioning angles, launch hooks, offers, and the first-30-day testing wave.

Mine customer reviews, support tickets, competitor ads, and market trends to identify winning angles, hooks, and offers per brand and per product.

Build and maintain a rolling 4-week testing roadmap per brand, re-prioritized weekly around the launch calendar.

Maintain a swipe file and creative reference library of top-performing ads in supplements, skincare, haircare, and adjacent categories.



Briefing & Production Management



Write detailed, unambiguous creative briefs for video editors, UGC creators, and designers.

Source, brief, and direct UGC creators and influencers to produce authentic, conversion-focused, compliant content.

Manage the production pipeline to hit the weekly output targets above with fast turnaround and consistent quality.



Performance Analysis & Iteration



Partner with media buyers to track CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate, and thumb-stop rate by concept, angle, brand, and product.

Run a weekly scale/kill/iterate decision cadence and feed learnings directly into the next round of concepts.

Report creative performance, testing learnings, and revenue attribution of winning concepts to leadership on a weekly cadence.



Brand, Compliance & Collaboration



Keep all creative on-voice and on-brand for each of the four brands, adapted to each platform's native format.

Ensure ad compliance across supplements (health claims) and beauty/personal care (cosmetic claims) on every concept and brief.

Align creative with each brand's marketing calendar, promotions, and product launch schedule.



Required Qualifications



3+ years working strictly in creative strategy or creative direction for paid social — this is not an editor, media buyer, or generalist marketing role.

That experience must be with CPG or telehealth brands (supplements, health & wellness, beauty, or personal care strongly preferred).

Proven track record of concepting ads that drove measurable revenue — you will be asked to show 3–5 ads with the numbers (spend, CPA/ROAS, run time) and your hypothesis behind each.

Demonstrated ability to sustain a high-volume, multi-brand pipeline (15+ concepts/week) without sacrificing quality.

Experience supporting new product launches, not just scaling established products.

Strong command of Meta and TikTok ad formats, native best practices, and DTC customer psychology (hooks, angles, offers, awareness levels).

Fluent reading of paid social performance data to guide creative decisions.

Experience writing briefs and directing video editors and UGC creators.

Excellent written and verbal English; strong project management across a multi-brand pipeline.

Based in the Philippines with reliable internet; able to maintain at least 3–4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time for standups and media buyer syncs.

Comfortable with — and motivated by — a fully performance-based, independent contractor engagement. Your upside is uncapped and tied directly to the revenue your winning concepts generate.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with an omni-channel brand selling across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and DTC.

Experience running creative for multiple brands or a brand portfolio simultaneously.

Familiarity with Motion, Foreplay, or similar creative analytics/inspiration tools.

Working knowledge of ad compliance requirements for supplements, health claims, and cosmetics.

Basic hands-on ability with editing or design tools (a plus, not a requirement).



Compensation & What We Offer



100% performance-based compensation: you earn 5% of ad spend attributable to winning creative concepts, paid monthly. A "winning concept" and its attribution methodology are defined in writing before your first sprint.

Uncapped upside: a single concept that scales a product toward $1M/month pays accordingly. There is no ceiling on what a top performer earns here.

Independent contractor engagement: full-time-equivalent commitment, invoiced monthly under a contractor agreement — you own your schedule outside required team overlap hours.

A dynamic, fast-growing four-brand portfolio with real ownership of the creative engine.

Career growth into a Creative Director / Head of Creative Strategy seat as the portfolio scales.



How to Apply



Send your resume plus: (1) 3–5 of your best-performing ads with the numbers (spend, CPA or ROAS, how long they ran) and the hypothesis behind each, and (2) a short note or 1-minute Loom on how you would structure the first 30 days of creative testing for a new supplement launch targeting $1M/month. 



Applications without performance examples will not be reviewed.

Job Title: B2B Marketing Lead & Digital Strategist (GoHighLevel & Strategy)



Are you a hybrid marketer who blends high-level B2B storytelling with strategic campaign orchestration? 



CDM Direct is a premium provider of Human-Led, AI-Powered outsourced services and customer experience solutions for major brands across Australia and New Zealand. We are seeking a highly autonomous Marketing Lead based in the Philippines to take ownership of our digital marketing strategy, drive inbound lead generation, and serve as the central project orchestrator for our digital footprint. 



This is an independent contractor role, engaged through our parent holding company, TKW Collective NZ Ltd.

This is not a generalist content role. We are looking for a proactive problem-solver who can own our B2B narrative, architect complex CRM pipelines, and smartly manage external technical specialists to deliver high-end digital outcomes at optimal costs. 



What You Will Do:

•	Drive the Digital Strategy: Act as the trusted advisor to the CEO, leveraging data and CRM analytics to ensure all marketing activities directly feed the sales pipeline. 



What We Are Looking For:



•	5–7 years of dedicated experience executing B2B brand strategy and marketing complex solutions to senior decision-makers. 



•	Hands-on expertise utilising GoHighLevel for advanced campaign automation. 



•	Proven experience acting as a digital project manager—briefing and managing external freelancers to achieve cost-effective technical results.



•	A decisive business mindset with exceptional, native-level English copywriting and verbal communication skills. 

Contractor Engagement Terms & Fees:



•	Engagement Type: Independent Contractor – Remote (Philippines-based). 



•	Contracting Entity: TKW Collective NZ Ltd. Contractors are responsible for their own local taxes and statutory obligations. 



•	Hours: Full-time equivalent (40 hours per week) aligned with Australian Business Hours (AEST/AEDT).

This is designed to support the provision of high-specification laptop hardware, robust enterprise-grade broadband, comprehensive uninterruptible power supply (UPS) backups, and business-tier LLM/AI software subscriptions.

title: Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research
description:
Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines (Metro Manila or Cebu preferred for talent network access)

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a senior operations leader to take ownership of our CATI call floor — and to help shape what comes next. This is a senior, long-term partnership with a genuine strategic dimension, and the package reflects that:



• Lead the bridge to AI-assisted interviewing — the role includes contributing to a voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Detail below.

• Direct line to the COO — you’ll report straight to the Chief Operating Officer of TKW Research Group. No middle layers.

• Base retainer: ?130,000 – ?180,000 PHP per month, commensurate with seniority, paid in arrears.

• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.

• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing dialler, CATI platform, and methodology training so you can perform at the highest level.

• Real ownership of how the floor runs, working directly with senior ANZ leadership — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We run multi-market CATI fieldwork for ANZ and international market research clients, and we’re looking for an experienced operations manager to take ownership of the call floor. You’ll be responsible for fieldwork execution, dialler performance, quota management, and the productivity of our interviewer teams.



This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You’ll have real autonomy over how the floor runs, but you’re also expected to roll up your sleeves — personally running shifts when needed and working directly with front-line interviewers, not just managing through layers. You’ll be accountable for hitting completion targets, maintaining quality, and keeping projects on budget.



The Hybrid Future — What Makes This Different



Every senior CATI manager knows what’s coming. Voicebots are going to reshape telephone interviewing within the next few years, and operations leaders fall into two camps: those who get sidelined by it, and those who lead the transition. We’re looking for the second kind.



TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that can conduct natural-sounding interviews at scale. Your role in this isn’t theoretical: as the voicebot moves from pilot to production, you’ll be the operational lead running the blended human/voicebot floor. D
 which interviews go to human interviewers and which go to the voicebot. Managing quality across both channels. Calibrating the hybrid model to deliver better data than either could alone.



If you’ve been waiting for a CATI role where you get to shape what telephone research becomes — rather than manage its slow decline — this is it.



What You’ll Do



• Manage CATI fieldwork end-to-end: sample distribution, quota matrices, completion tracking.

• Personally run live shifts when required — this is not a desk-only role. You’ll be on the floor (remotely) directing interviewers in real time, especially during critical fieldwork windows and across time zones.

• Monitor dialler performance in real time — contact rates, call dispositions, interviewer yield — and make tactical calls to keep productivity up.

• Coordinate Shift Supervisors, QA staff, and a remote interviewer pool.

• Troubleshoot operational issues live and work directly with the survey programming team when scripts need adjustments.

• Maintain ISO 20252 / ESOMAR-aligned quality processes.

• Produce daily and weekly operational reporting for the COO.



What We’re Looking For



• 7+ years in CATI operations within a market research agency or fieldwork BPO, with 3+ years in a senior management role.

• Strong working knowledge of dialler logic, CATI platforms, and call centre KPIs.

• Genuinely good with front-line interviewers — you can motivate, coach, and direct base-level interviewers directly, not just manage through supervisors. The best candidates have come up through the floor and haven’t lost the common touch.

• Solid grasp of market research methodology: sampling, quotas, weighting basics, and QA standards (ISO 20252, ESOMAR).

• Forward-looking on AI in research — you don’t need technical AI experience, but you should see voicebots as an opportunity to lead, not a threat to manage around.

• Comfortable with flexible shift patterns to cover multi-timezone fieldwork (agreed in advance — not random).

• Home office with reliable power, dual internet connections, and a setup capable of running monitoring tools and video calls daily.

• Strong written and spoken English.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The largest CATI operation you’ve personally run (team size, markets, sample volumes).

2. The dialler platforms you know best.

3. Your shift flexibility.

4. Your view on how voicebots will reshape telephone interviewing — and where you see your role in that shift.

Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent (approx. 40 hrs/week)



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a Survey Programmer to join us on a long-term contract basis. This is a real partnership, not a transactional gig — and a chance to contribute to something genuinely new in market research. The package reflects that:



• Front-row seat on a voicebot R&D project — you’ll contribute directly to a survey voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Real conversational-AI exposure on your CV.



• Base retainer: ?90,000 – ?140,000 PHP per month, commensurate with experience and voicebot project involvement, paid in arrears.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing platform training (Voxco and related tools) so you can perform at the highest level.



• Direct relationship with senior project managers in Australia/New Zealand — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Survey Programmer who can take complex questionnaires and turn them into clean, well-tested, production-ready survey scripts. You’ll own the scripting pipeline end-to-end: build, test, launch, deliver data.



Direct experience with Voxco is ideal, but we’re equally open to strong programmers from Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics who can pick up Voxco quickly — and we’ll fund the training to get you there. What matters more is that you can write real JavaScript (not just drag-and-drop survey builder logic) and that you sweat the details on QA.



The Voicebot Project — What Makes This Different



Alongside your core scripting work, you’ll contribute to something most survey programmers never get to touch: TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that conducts genuine, natural-sounding interviews at scale.



Your role on the project: building the underlying survey logic, question structures, routing, and validation rules that the voicebot will run. You’re not expected to be an ML engineer — you’re the survey expert who makes sure the conversational layer asks the right questions in the right order and captures clean data on the other side.



This is genuine R&D work with commercial backing. You’ll be one of a handful of survey programmers globally with hands-on conversational-AI experience on your CV.



What You’ll Do

• Translate questionnaires (Word, PDF, client-supplied) into interactive online and CATI scripts.

• Build complex logic: skip patterns, routing, piping, randomisation, quota management, custom validations.

• Write JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 to extend platform functionality where the out-of-the-box tools fall short.

• Test thoroughly — logic, edge cases, mobile rendering, accessibility — before anything goes live.

• Export and format data (SPSS, CSV, Excel) for the analysis team.



What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years programming surveys in a market research agency, fieldwork house, or specialised BPO.

• Strong JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 — you should be comfortable debugging in browser dev tools.

• Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise platform: Voxco, Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics.

• Bonus points for SPSS syntax, Python, SQL, or experience with conjoint/MaxDiff modules.

• Genuine interest in conversational AI — you don’t need ML experience, but you should be curious about how survey methodology and voice AI intersect.

• Reliable home office: high-spec PC, dual monitors preferred, stable internet plus a backup option.

• Strong written English — you’ll be communicating with project managers in Australia and New Zealand.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The platforms you’ve worked on.

2. The most complex script you’ve built.

3. Your earliest available start date.

4. A sentence or two on why the voicebot project interests you.

title: Fitness Sales Appointment Setter (Full-Time) | US Fitness Coaching Brand
description:
We are a US-based online fitness coaching business. Our founder is a national-level physique competitor and former aerospace engineer, and we help clients transform their health through 16-week coaching programs. We have 95,000+ engaged followers across TikTok,
, Instagram, and YouTube. Your job is to turn that audience into booked sales calls.



**THE ROLE**



You will be the first human touchpoint for people interested in our coaching. You start genuine conversations in the DMs, build rapport over time, and book warm, qualified leads directly into our founder's Calendly.



This is a relationship-first role. We do NOT want spammy copy-paste blasting. We provide proven templates; you personalize every message and let conversations develop naturally. Rapport first, appointment second.



**WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY**



- Send 200 to 300 outbound DMs per day across our platforms (TikTok is the top priority, then Instagram, then
, then YouTube)

- Personalize our message templates for each person based on their profile and engagement

- Nurture replies at a natural pace and move warm leads toward a sales call

- Book interested leads directly into Calendly

- Write a short summary of every conversation that leads to a booked call

- Log your daily numbers (DMs sent, replies, conversations, calls booked)



**COMPENSATION**



- Performance based commission on booked calls that turns into a closed sale. Commission scales with the program tier the client purchases: closing our premium program pays roughly triple what our entry program pays, so nurturing quality leads directly increases your income

- You receive a conversion report so you always know exactly which of your bookings closed and what you've earned

- Total earnings for a consistent performer land well above typical full-time setter rates, with no hard ceiling on the commission side

- Exact figures are shared at the interview stage



Note: commission is paid on CLOSED sales, not just booked calls. This role rewards setters who book genuinely interested people, not calendar-stuffers.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word MACKEREL as the very first word and the subject of the message. Applications that do not start with MACKEREL will be deleted without being read. This is how we filter for people who pay attention to detail, which is the #1 skill in this role.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- Excellent spoken and written English with a natural, conversational American tone

- Must be available to work US hours: 2-6PM and 7-11PM PST. This is a firm requirement; our audience is most active during US afternoons and evenings, and fast reply speed during those hours is core to this role. You must be highly available on chat during these times as well. No exceptions. 

- Experience as an appointment setter in the fitness space, DM setter, or chat-based sales role (fitness, coaching, or online business niche)

- Comfortable with high daily volume without losing warmth or quality

- Full-time availability, reliable internet, strong self-management

- Familiar with TikTok, Instagram, and
 
 interfaces

- Manychat and Meta Business Suite is a plus



**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**



- Not a hard-sell or pressure role. If you burn leads by rushing them, this is not the right fit.

- Not a content creation or design role.

- You do not close sales on calls. You book them; our founder closes them.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Your application must include ALL of the following, in this order:



1. The word MACKEREL as the very first word of your application

2. A short intro: your setter/DM experience and the niches pertinent to this role 

3. Your response to this scenario, written exactly as you would send it: A woman comments "I need to lose fat". Write your opening DM to her.

4. Your earliest start date and confirmation that you can work full-time on the stated US hours schedule



Applications missing any of these four items will not be considered.

title: Stock Management Admin (Big Seller)
description:
Join our team and become part of a dynamic, global organization of 40 professionals across Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Collaborate closely with our regional teams to grow an exciting portfolio of leading Korean brands, including Beauty of Joseon, Needly, Tirtir, and other top-trending names in the market.



We are specifically seeking a hands-on BigSeller ERP Expert. If you do not have direct, deep experience managing inventory, purchases, and syncing within BigSeller, please do not apply.



Key Responsibilities:



- Take ownership of the BigSeller account. Ensure "Available Stock" is perfectly synced across all stores to eliminate the risk of overselling during high-traffic mega-campaigns (11.11, 12.12).

- Manage the Inbound/Outbound process within BigSeller, including Stock-In (purchases), Stock-Out (promos/damage), and Warehouse Transfers.

- Lead weekly or monthly cycle counts and reconcile physical warehouse counts with BigSeller’s "On-Hand" data and resolve discrepancies between "On Hand," "Available," and "Reserved" stock.

- Use BigSeller’s "Purchase Suggestions" and historical sales data to forecast stock needs. Ensure we never hit "Zero Stock" on hero products.

- Create and track POs within BigSeller. Verify that "Stock-In" quantities match supplier invoices and update Costs to keep COGS accurate.

- Inspect returned items, update stock status and process replacements.

- Monitors stock sync between Bigseller and URStore.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide ad-hoc support.



Qualifications:



- 2–3 years of DIRECT, hands-on experience using BigSeller ERP (specifically the Stock Management, Reporting, and Purchase modules) is highly preferred.

- Proficient in Google sheets and Excel. Managing large datasets, utilizing advanced formulas (e.g., VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), and generating performance reports.

- Strong numeracy for calculating weighted average costs and reconciling bulk shipments.

- Highly organized, able to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in multicultural teams.

- Seeking a dedicated full-time and long term role.



Benefits:



- Stable full time with leave benefits, up to 14 days annual leave, holiday leave, birthday leave.

- Opportunity to be part of a growing team and Korean Beauty Brands.

- Travel Opportunity to Singapore during events.

- Comfortable work environment, same working time zone as the Philippines.

- Structured salary increase and promotion based on performance.
