Half 2: Appointment Coordinator



Run our three-call confirmation system with US homeowners: qualify new appointments, confirm details and decision-makers, and make final time checks

Follow our full call scripts (complete training provided — you'll know exactly what to say)

Log every call outcome accurately in our scheduling system — our pay and metrics run on your logs

You are the reason our appointment cancellation rate stays low, and you're bonused for it



PAY STRUCTURE (in USD)



Base: $1,400/month, paid twice monthly ($700 on the 15th, $700 + all bonuses at month end)

Sit-Rate Bonus: $150/month when the team's appointment sit rate is 90%+ ($100 at 85–89.9%)

Hiring Bonus: $50 for every new hire who completes our two-week training program

13th Month Pay: one extra month of base pay in December, pro-rated for partial years

Paid Time Off: 6 paid US holidays + 10 paid vacation days per year (taken during our slower seasons)

A strong month looks like: $1,400 base + $150 sit-rate bonus + $400 in hiring bonuses = $1,950. A strong full year with 13th month: $20,000+ USD

Compensation reviewed at the one-year mark for strong performers



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Excellent spoken English — warm, clear, confident, and natural on the phone. This is the #1 requirement. You'll be talking with American homeowners and job candidates all day.

At least 1–2 years of experience in a call center, BPO, appointment setting, recruiting, virtual assistance, or customer service role (voice experience strongly preferred)

Organized and self-managing — you'll run your own pipeline with real trust and real accountability

Detail-obsessed with logging and follow-up — our whole pay system depends on accurate records

Reliable setup: fast internet, backup power/internet plan, quiet workspace, quality headset

Able to genuinely commit to the US Eastern schedule long-term — please be honest with yourself about the night shift before applying

Coachable, honest, and looking for a home, not a gig



WHAT YOU GET FROM US



Complete training: a full written training packet, call scripts, recorded call examples, and a paid 30-day supervised ramp — you will never be thrown in unprepared

Direct access to the owners with a weekly video meeting

Stable, on-time pay in USD, every month, twice a month

A long-term seat in a growing program with a real leadership path



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is the first test)



Use the subject line: "Trusted Coordinator — [Your Name]"

In your application, tell us: your relevant experience, your internet speed and backup plan, and confirm you can work the US Eastern schedule

Include a 1–2 minute voice recording (Vocaroo or similar link) answering: "Tell us about a time you had to win someone's trust over the phone."



Applications without the subject line and voice recording will not be reviewed. We respond to qualified applicants quickly.

title: AI Operations Lead
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're a luxury marketing agency running Social/Design/Content, Web, Paid Ads, SEO/GEO, and Account Management as active teams — plus founders currently doing double duty on sales and business development. We want AI embedded across all of it, not bolted onto one team. This is a new, cross-functional role reporting directly into Strategy & Operations: you'll work across every department to find what's manual, automate it with AI, and make sure the whole company actually uses what you build.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Audit workflows across every team — Account Management, Web, Paid Ads, SEO/GEO, Social/Design/Content, and Business Development/Sales — and identify what AI can take off people's plates.

- Build and maintain automations connecting AI models (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to our existing tools, using Zapier, Make, n8n, APIs, or custom scripts.

- Stand up sales/BD automation specifically: lead research, outreach sequencing, proposal drafting, CRM hygiene, follow-up cadences — an area currently run ad hoc by the founders with no dedicated system.

- Build reusable prompt libraries, custom Claude Projects/GPTs, and SOPs so every team can use AI consistently, not just you.

- Train team leads (and their teams) on the tools and workflows you roll out — adoption is part of the job, not just the build.

- Evaluate new AI tools/models as they come out and make clear recommendations on what's worth adopting company-wide.

- Track and report time saved, cost saved, and output improved from what you automate — this role needs to show ROI.



REQUIRED

- Proven, hands-on experience using Claude and/or other frontier AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini) to automate real business processes — not just personal chatbot use.

- Experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n) or comfortable enough with APIs/scripting to wire tools together yourself.

- Experience automating or supporting sales/BD workflows specifically (CRM, outreach, lead gen, proposal generation) — this is a named priority, not a nice-to-have.

- Able to work cross-functionally — comfortable talking to a designer, a developer, a paid ads strategist, and a salesperson in the same week and tailoring automation to each.

- Strong documentation instincts — you write the SOP, not just build the workflow.

- Excellent written English, self-directed, able to own outcomes with minimal oversight.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in an agency or client-services environment.

- Basic coding skills (Python, JavaScript) for custom integrations.

- Experience with a CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, or similar) and sales automation tools specifically.

- Background training or onboarding a team onto new tools/workflows.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, apply with:

1. Your resume/portfolio.

2. 2-3 examples of processes you've automated with AI — what it looked like before, what you built, and the measurable impact.

3. One example specifically involving sales/BD or CRM automation, if you have it.

4. Start your application with the word "INTEGRATE" so we know you read the full post.



Applications without at least one concrete automation example will not be considered.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:

)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren

title: AI Generalist
description:
Looking for an AI Generalist



We are looking for an AI Generalist, someone who can take a script and a likeness and hand back finished, ultra realistic video. Generation, voice, lip-sync, quality control, all of it.



THE ROLE:



We produce realistic AI reels built around one consistent on camera personality. You own the machine that makes them.



End to end: identity training, prompting, model selection, voice cloning, lipsync, and the quality bar before anything reaches an editor.



This is daily volume work. Not one off projects.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:



- Strong skills creating realistic AI content (video and image)

- Hands on across the current stack: Higgsfield, Soul ID or LoRA style identity training, HeyGen, Kling, Veo, Seedance, ElevenLabs

- You can hold ONE face consistent across dozens of clips with zero drift

- You know which model to reach for per shot instead of forcing everything through one tool

- You catch the tells: dead eyes, bad hands, lipsync slip, plastic skin, and you re-render instead of shipping it

- You work from a real person's likeness, not just stock avatars or fully synthetic characters

- You document what worked so clip 50 is faster than clip 5

- Professional and reliable. This is not a "just getting started" role



BIG BONUS POINTS IF:



- You can edit too: clean cuts, text pop ups, motion, fonts, the polished pro stuff

- You have built a repeatable system, not just one off winners

- You understand hooks, pacing, and retention on short form

- You have run AI content that performed and can show the numbers



If you have that on top of everything else, you are exactly who we want.



HOW TO APPLY:



Do not send random AI content. We want to see the real person and the AI clone that holds up as a REAL person on camera.



Send:



1. Your best realistic AI clone or avatar work, polished

2. 3 or more clips of the SAME face so we can see consistency across generations

3. Your tool stack and how you would approach a daily volume build

4. A quick note on your experience and your rates



ROOM TO GROW:



This starts project based and scales into an ongoing role as output ramps. The right person grows into owning the full production pipeline and briefing the editors under them.



NEWER, BUT GOT THE SKILLS?



No client work yet but you make realistic AI content and can prove consistency? Make a sample and send it in. Skill speaks louder than a resume.



Excited to find the right person. Send your best.

title: GoHighLevel CRM, Automation & Sales Virtual Assistant
description:
GoHighLevel CRM, Automation & Sales Virtual Assistant



Perski Solutions is a Melbourne-based cleaning business looking for a reliable and experienced Virtual Assistant to help build and maintain our CRM, improve our sales follow-up, manage outreach, and support our online marketing.



This is not a basic data-entry position. We need someone who can take ownership of systems, keep leads organised, build practical automations, and help generate qualified business opportunities.



Position details



* Location: Remote

* Hours: [insert hours] per week

* Schedule: Flexible, with at least 3 hours of overlap with Melbourne business hours

* Pay: [insert hourly or monthly rate]

* Engagement: Long-term opportunity following a successful paid trial

* Trial period: Six weeks



Main responsibilities



GoHighLevel CRM



* Build, organise, and maintain our CRM in GoHighLevel.

* Create and manage sales pipelines, stages, contacts, opportunities, tags, custom fields, and follow-up tasks.

* Ensure all enquiries are entered into the CRM correctly.

* Keep lead records accurate and up to date.

* Monitor overdue follow-ups and make sure no lead is forgotten.

* Track lead sources, service requirements, sales activity, and outcomes.

* Create simple dashboards and weekly CRM reports.

* Document CRM processes so they are easy to understand and maintain.



Automation and Zapier



* Build and maintain GoHighLevel workflows and automations.

* Create and manage multi-step Zapier automations.

* Connect Webflow forms, GoHighLevel, Google Sheets, calendars,
, and other approved tools.

* Use Zapier Filters, Paths, Formatter, Delay, Schedule, and Webhooks where required.

* Create automatic lead notifications, follow-up tasks, reminders, and pipeline updates.

* Test all automations before activation.

* Monitor failed automations and troubleshoot errors.

* Prevent duplicate contacts, opportunities, tasks, and messages.

* Recommend when to use Zapier and when to use a native GoHighLevel workflow.



Sales outreach and lead generation

* Find and verify contact information.

* Conduct personalised
 and LinkedIn outreach.

AI tools

* Create reusable prompts for approved business tasks.

* Review and edit all AI-generated work before it is published or sent.

* Check AI outputs for accuracy, tone, and relevance.

* Never enter confidential customer or business information into unapproved AI tools.

* Use AI to improve efficiency without replacing human judgement.



Required experience



Applicants must have practical experience with:



* GoHighLevel CRM.

* GoHighLevel pipelines and workflows.

* Zapier and multi-step Zaps.

* CRM setup, maintenance, and lead tracking.

* Business automation.

* Sales outreach and lead generation.

* LinkedIn outreach and company-page management.

* AI tools such as ChatGPT.

* Strong written English.

* Google Sheets and online research.

* Accurate data entry and reporting.



Highly desirable experience



* Webflow website maintenance.

* SEO and local SEO.

* Google Analytics and Google Search Console.

* Canva and social media scheduling.

* Working with Australian businesses.

* Experience in real estate, property management, construction, cleaning, or another service business.

* Experience with APIs, webhooks, JSON, or Make.



What we are looking for



You should be:



* Reliable and organised.

* Comfortable working independently.

* Proactive about identifying problems.

* Able to follow instructions and documented processes.

* Confident asking questions when information is genuinely missing.

* Careful with customer data and account security.

* Focused on quality rather than simply completing a high number of tasks.

* Able to explain technical systems in simple language.

* Consistent with follow-up and reporting.



Initial six-week trial



Weeks 1–2: CRM and automation setup



You will:



* Review or set up our GoHighLevel CRM.

* Create the required pipelines and stages.

* Organise contact fields, tags, lead sources, and follow-up tasks.

* Connect Webflow enquiries to GoHighLevel.

* Build essential lead notifications and follow-up workflows.

Weeks 3–6: Sales and outreach pilot

 outreach.

Targets may be adjusted based on the final number of weekly hours.



How to apply

 outreach you have completed.

Applications without the requested information may not be reviewed.

title: AI Creative Producer, Luxury Content
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're a luxury marketing agency, and our clients expect a certain bar: polished, premium, expensive looking. We want someone who lives inside AI video and image generation tools and can produce content at that bar consistently. If your work still looks like "AI made this," this role isn't a fit. If people can't tell, you're exactly who we need.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Produce high quality video and visual content for luxury clients using leading AI generation tools (Runway, Kling, Sora, Midjourney, Ideogram, Luma, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, and similar), for campaigns, social content, and ad creative.

- Finish and polish AI generated footage and images to a client-ready standard: color, motion, sound, typography, pacing. Raw AI output is a starting point, not a deliverable.

- Match each client's brand voice, aesthetic, and visual identity exactly. No generic AI look, no visible artifacts, no uncanny valley.

- Build repeatable workflows and prompt techniques so quality stays consistent project to project.

- Present concepts and drafts to internal leads and, at times, directly to clients.

- A portfolio of AI-generated video and visual work that looks genuinely premium. This is the single most important thing you can send us. No portfolio, no consideration.

- Deep hands-on fluency with current AI video and image generation tools, not just theoretical knowledge of what they can do.

- Real editing/post-production skill to finish AI output (Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or similar).

- A sharp, trained eye for what "luxury" actually looks like: lighting, pacing, restraint, detail. This is a taste job as much as a technical one.

- Excellent written English, self-directed, able to take a brief and run with minimal hand-holding.



NICE TO HAVE

- Prior experience in luxury, fashion, jewelry, watches, or premium hospitality content.

title: Video Editor & Ad Creative Producer (Full Time)
description:
VIDEO EDITOR & AD CREATIVE PRODUCER (Full Time, Long Term)



This is a full time, long term position for a video editor and ad designer who wants three things: a stable job with pay that arrives on time every single time, real growth in both salary and skill, and training from people who are genuinely great at what they do.



We're a US-based advertising and lead generation company running direct response ad campaigns, and we're adding one person to own our creative production, videos and still image ads both, as we scale. Our founder owns strategy and writes the briefs. You own turning them into finished ads.



Here's what you get:



- Full time, consistent monthly pay: $800 to $1,100 USD per month depending on experience, plus 13th month pay

- Raises tied to growth. We're scaling our ad campaigns aggressively, and the people who help us get there are the first to be rewarded for it.

- Complete training and guidance. You will never be left guessing what to make. Every project comes with a script, reference ads to model, and detailed feedback, so you get better with every single ad you produce.

- Mentorship that raises your market value for life. You'll be trained directly by our founder, who has spent the last eight years running paid advertising at a high level and has overseen more than $25 million in ad spend. Very few editors ever get to learn direct response advertising from someone who's actually done it at this level.



What you'll be doing:



- Owning the creative production pipeline: every project comes with a script, a documented brief, and reference ads, and you own the execution

- Editing mobile-first video ads for
 and Instagram (vertical 9x16, captions on screen, built for sound-off viewing)

- Designing static image ads in the same direct response style, and cutting new variations of every winning ad

- Taking a brief (script, reference ads, footage) and turning it into a finished ad

- Producing volume. We test constantly, so you'll be making a lot of variations every week.

- You will have FULL ACCESS to higgsfield AI credits!



We run lead generation campaigns (insurance), not ecommerce. If your experience is ecommerce, that is fine, we can teach you our world. If you have edited for lead generation, direct response, or insurance offers before, say so in your application, it is a real plus. 



The number one skill in this role is attention. The first three seconds of an ad d
 whether someone clicks or not. We need someone who understands hooks, pacing, and captions, and who knows how to keep someone watching on a phone screen instead of scrolling past. Our audience demographic is 60 and older, so clarity beats flashiness. Big readable text, clean simple pacing, nothing confusing.



What we're looking for:



- Strong editing skills in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar

- A portfolio that includes actual ads (social media ads, UGC style videos, short form content)

- Graphic design ability (Photoshop or Canva) is a big plus

- Good English comprehension

- Reliable internet and computer

- Someone who wants to be here for years, growing with the company. If you're juggling five freelance clients at once, this probably won't be the right fit.



HOW TO APPLY (read this carefully):



Send links to the 3 best video ads you've ever edited, plus at least one static image ad you designed. Just your best work, no need to send everything you've ever made. In one sentence, tell us what kind of offers you've edited for (ecommerce, lead generation, local businesses, etc.). If you have a before and after example showing raw footage next to your final cut, even better. Start your application with the word HOOK so we know you actually read this whole post.



No cover letter needed. Your work does the talking. The best applicants get a small paid test project, and the person who wins that gets the job.

title: Sales Development Representative - AI Start-Up, Melbourne, Australia
description:
Fun and Exciting opportunity

 $10USD base rate per month / $5 USD for an appointment / $15 for a close 

About FlashFillz

We're an Australian AI company solving a problem every medical booking service practice has: when a patient cancels at the last minute, that appointment slot — and the revenue with it — usually disappears.

Our system fixes that automatically. The moment a cancellation comes in, FlashFillz texts the practice's waitlist and the first person to respond claims the slot. No phone calls. No admin. No empty chair.

The platform is built, security-audited, and running in production. We're now taking it to market across Melbourne's dental and medical sector — and we're hiring our first two SDRs to help us do it.



Why this role is different

You won't be employee number 200 reading from a call centre script. You'll be one of the first two people in our sales function, working directly with the founders. The scripts you refine, the objections you learn, the process you help build — that becomes the playbook for everyone who joins after you.



We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for two people who want to build something and grow with it.



What you'll do

Call Australian dental and medical practices from a qualified, pre-researched list — we do the list building, you do the conversations. Your job is to book qualified appointments for our Melbourne-based closers. That's it. You're not closing deals or handling contracts.



You'll log every call outcome, and that data directly shapes how we sell. When you find something that works, we roll it out to the whole team.



The path forward



This is a genuine growth role, and we'll be specific rather than vague about it. Consistently hit 20 booked appointments per week for two months and you move into a Team Lead position — training our next hires, with a share of what your team books. We're building a sales organisation, and the first two people here are the ones who'll run it.



The three skills that matter most



1. Clear, confident spoken English. You'll be speaking with Australian practice managers and receptionists every day. You need to be easy to understand, warm on the phone, and comfortable when someone is busy or abrupt.



2. Cold calling resilience. Most calls end in a no. The people who succeed in this role treat that as information, not rejection, and pick up the phone again immediately.



3. Genuine organisation. Every call logged, every follow-up scheduled, every outcome recorded accurately. Our entire sales system runs on the data you capture.



Details

Full-time, working Australian business hours (approximately 6:00am–3:00pm Manila time). Base rate plus a bonus for every appointment booked that shows up. Full training on the product and the market — you don't need healthcare experience, you need to be able to hold a good conversation. 



We have the list, you make the calls, and follow up with us, record this fun journey as we build something amazing.

We're reading every application personally, this is a really fun and exciting oppotunity

title: Customer Service + Supplier Operations, E-commerce
description:
## Customer Service + Supplier Operations, E-commerce (Part-Time, Remote)



We run fast-growing online fashion and jewellery stores selling into the US and Australia. We are an AI-forward operation: our systems are modern, documented and fast, and we expect you to work the same way. The job is judgement calls, upset customers, refunds done right, chargebacks fought with evidence, and suppliers chased until every problem order is closed.



We recently let someone go for being slow, unresponsive, lazy with the workload, and loose with our SOPs. We are not writing around it: this role is for someone fast, present during their shift, who follows the process exactly, and who fixes things without being asked. If that is not you, this ad will save us both time.



For the right person, this is the opposite of a gig. It is a long-term seat with steady work for time to come as the store portfolio grows, and you will be working with, and trained on, the latest AI tools available to a VA anywhere. Capable people get rewarded and invested in here. We just do not hold hands.



### What you will own



This is the whole job. There is no training wheels version. We give you documented systems, a full manual and macro book, and modern AI tooling. From there you run it.



- **The inbox.** Run it end to end. Personally handle anything sensitive: refunds, disputes, angry customers. Every reply that goes out is yours, and we spot-check them.

- **Refunds.** Follow our refund and remedy ladder exactly. Partial offers up to a hard ceiling; full refunds are owner-approved, always. Zero improvising. You hold the refund lever and we audit it.

- **Chargebacks and payment disputes.** Compile evidence (order records, tracking, correspondence, policy) and submit responses within 48 hours of a dispute landing. You will have done this before; tell us where.

- **Supplier operations.** Log and chase holds, address changes, cancellations, reships, lost parcels and wrong-item claims through our supplier queue, daily, until closed. Nothing sits in silence.

- **The books.** Every refund, dispute, store credit and paid replacement logged in our trackers, same day, accurately. If it is not in the sheet, it did not happen.

- **Reporting.** A short end-of-day report every shift. A Friday voice-of-customer digest: top complaint themes and what customers keep asking for.

- **Order risk.** Same-day warm confirmation
s on flagged high-value orders, escalated immediately if anything smells wrong.



### What you will be measured on



- First reply to every customer within 2 hours during your shift; overnight tickets answered in the first hour of your next shift.

- 95% of tickets fully resolved within two replies.

- Refund ladder followed exactly; zero unauthorized refunds.

- Every chargeback answered with evidence within 48 hours.

- No problem order waits more than 24 hours for a supplier follow-up.

- Trackers and end-of-day report complete every shift, no chasing.

- 99%+ of scheduled shifts covered. If life happens, we hear from you at least 2 hours before shift with a written handover.



### You are probably a fit if



You have 4+ years in e-commerce customer service and Shopify is second nature to you, not a bonus point. You have personally answered chargebacks and coordinated with suppliers on dropshipping order problems. You use AI tools every day and pick up new ones fast. Your English, written and spoken, is excellent: clear, warm and mistake-free, good enough that customers assume they are talking to a native speaker. You follow SOPs exactly, and when one seems wrong you flag it instead of freelancing around it. You communicate proactively: we hear about problems from you before we notice them ourselves. Your last clients would call you the most reliable person they have worked with, and you notice broken things and fix them before anyone asks.



### You are not a fit if



We measure output, not hours online, and our tooling raises what one hour must produce here. Not a fit: you need daily supervision, you do the minimum and call it done, you go quiet when messaged, you treat SOPs as suggestions, you improvise on refunds, you have never touched a chargeback, you have never run a Shopify store's inbox, or your recent clients would hesitate when asked about your attendance or your speed.



### How we hire, so you know upfront



A short application, a 20-minute call, one longer interview walking through your work history, and we speak with your recent bosses or clients, so answer everything as if they are in the room. Finalists do a paid trial week on real tickets, scored against the numbers above. We d
 fast in both directions: hit the numbers and you have a long-term seat; miss them and the trial is where it ends.



### Pay, hours and terms



US$4/hour, paid on time, every time. Part-time: regular daily shifts with real ticket volume from day one, and hours that grow as sales scale; at full volume we run two reps on alternating shifts. Rate reviewed against your numbers at 90 days. Long-term role with growth as the store portfolio expands.



### To apply



Write your application yourself. We use AI every day and recognise AI-drafted applications and cover letters instantly; they do not impress us, and they go straight to the bin. We are looking for genuinely capable individuals, and the reward for being one is a long-term role and real skills with the newest tools in this trade.



 
 with a subject line containing the word **PERIDOT**, and include:



1. A voice note or Loom, 60 to 90 seconds, unscripted: the angriest customer you ever handled. What happened, what you did, how it ended.

2. One number: how many scheduled work days you missed in the last six months.

3. One sentence: which AI tools you use daily, and for what.

4. One line: how many chargebacks you have personally answered, and on which platform (Shopify Payments, PayPal, Stripe, other).

title: Sauna Sales & Support Specialist - $1,100 base + commission (realistic $2,000–$3,500/mo) - US EST Hours
description:
Read this whole post before applying. There's a specific instruction at the bottom and I only read applications that follow it.



We sell sauna heaters and sauna kits across the United States. Our customers are homeowners building a new sauna or looking to replace/upgrade their sauna heater, construction companies specifying equipment for a client, and professional sauna builders ordering for multiple projects. Orders range from a single heater to complete saunas well over $10,000.



They come to us because they need to figure out what to buy. What size heater for the room. Whether the specs work for the build. Which brands/models hold up. Your job is to be the person who works that out with them and gets the order.



This is a sales role with a real support component, not a ticket-closing job. 



COMPENSATION



Base: $1,100 USD/month

Commission: 1% of every order you close. We sell complete sauna packages upwards of $10,000, so the bigger orders pay real money

Realistic total: $2,000–$3,500/month once you're ramped



THE HOURS



9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



This is a varied role. Some of it is live conversation, but a lot of it is quiet work: figuring out the right answer, building the quote, and chasing it down.



Sales:

- Take inbound sales calls and texts from homeowners, contractors and sauna builders

- Make outbound calls and texts to warm prospects who've enquired, requested a quote, or abandoned a cart

- Research the right solution for a customer's build and put together product recommendations based on their room, their timeline and their budget

- Create quotes in Shopify and send them out

- Follow up on open quotes. This is where most of the commission lives, and it's the part most people neglect

- Take orders over the phone



Support:

- Handle inbound chat and

- Answer technical questions about heater and sauna specifications

- Work through problems with customers, including liaising with vendors' technical teams to get a real answer rather than a guess

- Process returns and refunds

- Follow up with customers after their equipment arrives, to make sure the install went well and to catch problems early

- Realistically, you will not be on the phone all day. Expect a mix: sales and support calls, then long stretches of research, quoting, follow-up and
.



WHO THIS IS FOR



Required:

- Near-native spoken and written English. Clear and easy for an American to understand on a bad phone connection, and clean enough to write a quote
 to a contractor

- Real sales experience. If you've sold anything expensive over the phone or by
 - HVAC, hot tubs, pools, generators, solar, appliances, windows, building materials, insurance, real estate and of course saunas, I want to talk to you

- Comfortable with a customer who says "let me think about it," and willing to follow up until you get an answer

- Organised enough to keep 30 open quotes moving without dropping any

- 50+ WPM typing

- Reliable internet (10 Mbps+) and a quiet place to take calls

- You can commit to these hours for at least a year



Nice to have, genuinely not required:

- Shopify experience

- Anything to do with saunas, spas, pools, hot tubs, construction or home improvement

- Basic electrical literacy (volts, amps, breakers)

- You do not need to know anything about saunas. We'll teach you that, and we have the materials to do it properly. What we can't teach is how you sound on the phone and whether you chase a quote.



ABOUT US



We're a team of 20 running several ecommerce sites. It's a close, highly motivated group and everyone here cares about doing the work properly. You won't get lost in a corporate structure, and you won't be firefighting at midnight either. Steady work, taken seriously, by people who like working together.



On a team this size your work is visible from day one. If this goes well, you'd be training the next hires and eventually leading the team.



HOW TO APPLY



Three things. Applications missing any of them get skipped, no exceptions.



1. Start your message with the word SAUNA-READY so I know you read this far.

2. Record a video clip (not audio) covering two parts:



Part 1 - introduce yourself. How much sales experience you have, whether you've used Shopify, what industries you've worked in, and why we should hire you. Keep it tight.



Part 2 - answer this as if you were on the phone with a real customer:



"Hi, I'm building a sauna in my backyard. It's about 7 feet by 8 feet with a 7-foot ceiling, and one wall is going to be glass. I have no idea what size heater I need. Can you help?"

title: Sales & Patient Acquisition Lead — $1,000+/month Potential (US Hours)
description:
PLEASE READ FIRST — do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph.

Applications sent through this site are not reviewed. To be considered, you must apply through our own form here: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a

It takes about 10 minutes and includes a short voice recording.



Hi, I'm Dr. Abrar Al-Shaer, PhD, RD, LDN: a registered dietitian nutritionist and herbalist in the United States. I run Precision Women's Care, an integrative practice where we help women get to the root of their health issues — PCOS, fertility, hormones, gut health, perimenopause — and feel like themselves again.



We're a small, close team, fully remote, and we care a great deal about the women who come to us.



Women find us, reach out, and genuinely want help — and then some of them quietly slip away because nobody followed up well enough. I'm looking for someone to own our front door: the leads, the phone, the follow-up, and the conversation that turns an interested woman into a patient.



This is a sales role, and it's also the first voice a woman hears from our practice. Both have to be true at once.



About the pay, before anything else. Your base is $7/hour, but this role is built so your income follows your results, not the clock. You earn a bonus on every patient and member you bring in, so $1,000+ a month is well within reach if you convert well. Do this properly and you should out-earn the hourly rate comfortably.



What you'll do

- Follow up quickly with every woman who reaches out, and guide her toward booking

- Have the real conversation: what we offer, what it costs, and what's holding her back

- Turn interested women into patients and members

- Keep following up with the ones who say "let me think about it" — this is where most of the value lives

- Answer and return calls on our practice phone during US hours

- Schedule patient follow-ups and make sure nothing sits unanswered



Who I'm looking for



Near-native English comes first, and it isn't negotiable. You'll be on the phone with American women talking about deeply personal things. You need to sound warm, natural, and completely at ease — able to hear hesitation in someone's voice and respond to it. Not scripted. Not stiff.



- You've actually sold something and closed it. Health, wellness, coaching, or memberships is a real plus

- You're comfortable with money. You can say a price out loud and then stay quiet

- You're warm, not pushy. Hard-closing will damage the trust our patients place in us

- You run yourself. You'll own the follow-up. Nobody will chase you

- You can work a consistent 4-hour block each weekday, on US Eastern time

- This role is open to women only. Our patients are women discussing fertility and hormones, and they've told us plainly that they're more comfortable speaking with another woman



The details

- Pay: $7/hour base, plus a bonus on every patient and member you bring in. A strong month lands around $1,000+ per month

- Hours: 20 per week to start — the same 4-hour block each weekday, US Eastern

- Growth: 4-week paid fellowship ? 3 months part-time ? full-time based on performance

- We provide: our practice phone system, Notion, and Toggl



How to apply

1. Application and voice recording: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a.

2. Interview. A real conversation, with some role-play.

3. Fellowship. A paid 4 weeks working alongside us. That's how we both find out if this is right.



If you're wonderful on the phone and you want your work to genuinely change how a woman feels in her own body, I'd love to hear from you.



— Abrar

title: Senior Online Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Elite-level Internet Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist with proven experience handling difficult and high-profile online reputation cases. We work with high-profile individuals, including celebrities, executives, public figures, and brands, and we need someone who understands how to handle reputation issues that can spread rapidly across the internet.



This is not a traditional SEO or social media position.

We are looking for someone experienced in advanced content removal, search suppression, de-indexing, takedown coordination, and reputation recovery.



To give you a better understanding of the type of cases we handle:

Imagine a high-profile celebrity such as Beyoncé has an embarrassing i
 during a live performance. Someone records the i
, uploads the video, and within hours the footage is being reposted across Google, social media, news websites, and other platforms. We are looking for a specialist who understands how to approach a situation like this and legitimately pursue removal of the original and replicated content wherever possible, while also addressing the resulting search visibility. This is the level of complexity and urgency we are looking for—not simply removing a negative review or improving a Google ranking.



Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute advanced ORM strategies

- Identify the source and spread of damaging content

- Pursue legitimate content removal and takedown opportunities

- Evaluate available Google and platform removal processes

- Develop search-suppression strategies when removal is not possible

- Coordinate with publishers, platforms, and legal counsel when appropriate

- Develop authoritative content to strengthen positive search results

- Monitor Google rankings, indexing, and search visibility

- Provide regular reports and recommendations



Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:

- Advanced Online Reputation Management

- Viral or high-profile content removal

- Search-result suppression

- Google de-indexing and removal processes

- Website and platform takedowns

- Legal/policy-based removal requests

- Technical SEO

- High-authority content publishing

- Reputation management for celebrities, executives, or public figures

- Complex cases involving news websites, social platforms, government websites, court records, or other authoritative sources



We are not looking for someone who only has basic SEO, backlink building, keyword research, or Google review management experience. We need someone who has actually handled complex ORM cases and can demonstrate real results.



To Apply, please provide:

- Your ORM experience

- Examples of difficult cases you have handled

- Results you achieved

- Your experience with content removal, de-indexing, or search suppression

- Case studies, screenshots, or other proof of results where possible



If you have experience handling high-profile, viral, or difficult online reputation problems, we want to hear from you.

Successful candidates may have the opportunity to work with us on a long-term basis, with potential for a full-time position.

title: Closara: Performance Creative & Media Buyer
description:
Performance Creative & Media Buyer: Ad Editor Who Thinks Like a Marketer 



We're hiring an ad editor who thinks like a marketer:

We run a pay-per-lead model: we generate customer opportunities on
, Instagram and Google with paid ads. The single most important skill in that machine is yours: editing. You study industries and consumer psychology and package it into a high volume of ad creative that makes people click and buy. Great editing takes years to build — that's the craft we're hiring. The media buying behind it can be trained, and we will train you: step-by-step, exactly which buttons to press. If you already have media-buying experience, that's a major plus — but the editor is who we're hiring.

This is a partnership, not a task job — direct mentorship, SOPs, and the room to grow into leading the creative and media team as we scale.



Compensation: USD $1,000–$1,500/month base (for the right person — we pay for a weapon) + 1% uncapped performance commission.

Type: Full-time, work from home, long-term.

Hours: ~8 hours/day plus a lunch break. Start between 9:00–10:00am Philippine time (11:00am PHT at the latest) — e.g. 10am–7pm PHT. You'll overlap Melbourne (AEST) afternoon/evening, with a short daily check-in at the start of your day after you send a morning brief. Then a sharp concise EOD report. 



What You'll Do:

Creative — your craft, most of the week

-Edit a high volume of short-form video ads for Meta, Instagram and YouTube — hooks, angles, variations. Volume of tested creative is our #1 lever, so you ship in batches.

-Produce static image creatives, including AI-generated statics (Nano Banana or similar).

-Build AI ad videos with tools like Kling, Veo3, Seedance, Higgsfield, kie.ai.

-Study the industries and the psychology — what makes people click and buy. Pitch angles and concepts; think for yourself, don't just cut what you're told.

Media buying — where this role grows (we train you)

-Learn to launch, test, kill and scale the Meta/Google campaigns behind your creative to a target cost-per-lead — with full training, SOPs and videos on exactly what to do.

-Read the data and feed what the numbers say straight back into the next batch of creative — the creative-to-CPL loop is yours to own over time.

-You don't need to be a fancy, elite editor — in advertising, clean and minimal converts. What matters is creativity, marketing instinct and speed.



You're Our Person If You Have

The one hard requirement:

A portfolio of ad creative you've personally edited — video and static. This is the gate. No portfolio, no application. Editing at this level takes years to build, and it's the skill we're hiring.



-Real video editing (CapCut / Premiere / After Effects) and static design — 3+ years of reps behind you.

-Fluency with AI creative tools — image and video generation — to move fast.

-A performance / lead-gen mindset (CPL / CPA) — NOT TikTok-influencer or brand-awareness content.

-Fluent written and spoken English.

-Full-time, single focus — no other clients on the side.

-Highly preferred — major points

-Media-buying experience — Meta / Google / YouTube. If you've personally run an ad account, show it (real CPL and spend). -Any performance-marketing experience counts strongly here. Don't have it yet? Still apply — we train the buying; we can't train the years of editing.

-Experience across multiple verticals; strong grasp of consumer psychology and direct-response.



Not This Role

So we're clear (and so the right people self-select): funnel building, GoHighLevel automation, landing pages and cold outreach are handled by others. You focus on creative and the ads. That's the whole job — done exceptionally.



Commission — How It Works

On top of base, you earn 1% of the collected margin on the client revenue your campaigns drive, every month that client stays. Uncapped.

-Example: a lead-buyer client spending $50k/month at ~40% margin ($20k) = $200/month to you while they're active. Ten of those = $2,000/month recurring, on top of base.

-A smaller $2,500/month client = $25/month, which stacks at volume.

These are illustrations of the mechanism, not a promise — but the ceiling is uncapped, and it's built to grow well beyond the base as we scale.



How To Apply:

Read carefully — we get over a thousand applications and skipping a step means instant deletion.

1. Start your message with the word VESICA so we know you actually read this.

2. Your portfolio — a Google Drive folder set to “anyone with the link,” showing ad creative you've edited (video + static).

3. THE TEST — build us one Closara ad. Look at our website (closara.co) and create a single ad (a static image OR a short video) for Closara. Show us your creative and the thinking behind it (the angle, the hook, why it would work). This is the main thing we'll judge.

4. If you have media-buying experience (major points): link or screenshots of an ad account you've personally run, showing real cost-per-lead and spend. No account? Skip this step — it won't delete you.

5. A short Loom introducing yourself in English. We don't care about production quality — we want to see you're serious.

6. One or two sincere lines: the best CPL or best-performing ad you've made, and why you want this role. Confirm your PHT hours and that you can commit full-time.



Show us a real portfolio and a Closara ad that makes us stop scrolling — and you'll hear from us fast.

title: Home Care Agency Office Assistant
description:
We are hiring both full-time & Part-time remote compliance specialist to support our company, which handles regulatory compliance, billing, and back-office operations for small home care agencies in the Midwest. The role is roughly 80% compliance work: reading Minnesota state statutes for example and licensing rules, translating them into practical checklists, auditing client and employee files against those requirements, building and pre-filling the required document templates, and tracking expiring items like background checks, trainings, and service agreements before they lapse. The remaining 20% is claims entry in the client's EHR system, setting up e-signature and form workflows, and general administrative support. Think of it as the compliance and office manager function inside a home care agency, done remotely.



No prior knowledge of US or State healthcare regulation is required — I will provide the source material and training. What I cannot train is the core quality I'm screening for: this person should be able to be handed a regulation they've never seen and come back with a working checklist and a list of smart questions, without being walked through it step by step. The work is document-heavy and detail-critical, since a single missing signature or expired certification can cost an agency its license, so accuracy and follow-through matter more than speed.



Backgrounds that translate well include paralegal, audit, quality assurance, healthcare administration, medical billing, accounting, or public health. This is a dedicated seat with evening hours to overlap US Central time, not a role to be split across multiple companies, and there is a clear path into a senior position as we add headcount.

title: Accounting Manager – US Construction Company
description:
ABOUT REPUBLIC HOMEBUILDING & RENOVATIONS



Republic Homebuilding & Renovations is a design-build residential construction and remodeling firm based in Webster, Texas, serving homeowners throughout the Greater Houston area. We specialize in high-quality renovations, additions, and custom residential projects, combining thoughtful design, disciplined project management, and clear communication.



We run about ten active jobs at a time, ranging from $20,000 to $300,000. We use QuickBooks Online for accounting and JobTread for project management and job costing.



This is a fully remote role for a candidate based in the Philippines, working United States Central Time hours.





ABOUT THIS ROLE — PLEASE READ THIS PART



This is not a data-entry position. You will own the accounting function.



We have separate staff who enter bills, send invoices, chase documents, and track purchase orders. Your job is to own the close, own the reconciliations, own the job cost data, and review their work — not to do it yourself.



We are also going to be straightforward with you about something most job posts leave out: our historical books need cleanup work. Costs have not been consistently coded to the right jobs, and some accounts need to be reorganized. Your first ninety days include a defined cleanup project alongside normal monthly work. You will not be inheriting a perfectly clean system, and we are not pretending otherwise.



If that sounds like the kind of problem you enjoy solving, we want to hear from you. If it sounds like a headache, this is not the right role for you, and that is fine.





REQUIREMENTS



• Bachelor's degree in Accountancy

• 3+ years of accounting experience, including at least one year where you were personally responsible for closing the books every month — not assisting someone else who closed them

• Experience assigning costs to specific projects or jobs, including d
 which job a cost belongs to at the time you record it

• QuickBooks Online experience





STRONGLY PREFERRED



• Construction, remodeling, or contracting industry experience, especially US residential

• Experience with a project management or job-costing system alongside the accounting system (JobTread, Buildertrend, Procore, CoConstruct, or similar)

• Experience producing a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule using percentage-of-completion

• Experience closing books for more than one related entity, including intercompany transactions

• QuickBooks Online Advanced Certification / ProAdvisor

• CPA (PRC) licence



If you do not have every item on the preferred list, apply anyway. The four requirements above are what matter.





WORK SETUP REQUIREMENTS



• Reliable high-speed internet AND a reliable backup internet connection

• Backup power supply

• Reliable computer plus a backup device

• Willingness to use screenshot monitoring software on work computers

• This is a full-time, exclusive role. You may not hold another job or client engagement while employed here.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Monthly close

• Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts every month

• Produce the monthly financial package: profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow statement

• Produce a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule

• Prepare monthly reporting packages required by outside parties

• Close on a published schedule, not "when it gets done"



Job costing

• Ensure every cost is coded to the correct job and correct cost type when it is recorded

• Maintain a clean separation between job costs and company overhead, and apply it consistently

• Reconcile job cost data in QuickBooks against JobTread and resolve differences

• Produce per-job cost reporting the project team can actually rely on



Bank feed and payables

• You are the only person who touches the bank feed. Bank feed items must be matched to existing bills before they are categorized — never entered as new expenses when a bill already exists

• Maintain accounts payable and review vendor bills entered by admin staff

• Weekly review for duplicate or miscoded transactions



Other

• Run payroll and maintain payroll records

• Maintain the chart of accounts. You are the only person who may add or change accounts

• Review the work of the admin staff who enter bills and prepare invoices

• Reconciliation work extends to two affiliated partnerships in addition to the main company





YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS



We measure this role on deliverables, not on time served.



• By Day 14 — A written month-end close procedure, in your own words, that someone else could follow

• By Day 45 — First complete set of reconciliations across all bank, credit card, and loan accounts

• By Day 75 — First complete monthly financial package, delivered on schedule

• By Day 90 — Agreed cleanup milestones met, and job cost data usable for estimating





WHY YOU WILL LIKE WORKING HERE



• Real ownership. You are the accounting function, not a task-taker

• A defined problem with a defined finish line, and a company that already knows what is broken

• Admin support, so you are not buried in data entry

• Clear working hours, clear expectations, and deliverables you can point to

• Direct access to the company President. No layers

• Genuine US construction accounting experience: job costing, WIP, percentage-of-completion





SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday, 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM Philippine time (8:30 AM to 5:30 PM US Central), with one hour unpaid lunch. 40 hours per week.





OUR HIRING PROCESS



1. Resume and cover letter review

2. Short introductory video call

3. Paid two-hour work sample — a real reconciliation and job-costing exercise. We pay you at the role's hourly rate for your time, whether or not we make an offer. Finalists only

4. Reference check with a direct supervisor from a recent role

5. Offer



We do this because we would rather see how you work than hear about it.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.Ph application system.



Attach your resume as a PDF.



In your cover letter, answer these three questions directly. Applications that do not answer all three will not be reviewed.



1. Describe the last month-end close you personally owned. What company or client, what accounting software, what was on your checklist, and what day of the month did you finish?



2. When you enter a vendor bill, how do you d
 which job it belongs to? And what do you do when you genuinely cannot tell?



3. List every job, client, or engagement you currently hold, and the hours per week you spend on each.



Short, specific answers are better than long general ones. We are looking for what you actually did, not what you know about in principle.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Us:

We're a marketing and media production agency based in Melbourne, Australia. We shoot professionally and produce high-quality short-form social media content, and we operate as much as a media production house as we do a marketing agency. We handle both organic social content and paid Meta ad video production, and we place a strong emphasis on premium, high-quality production value across everything we put out.



The Role:

We're looking for a skilled Video Editor to join our team full-time, primarily editing short-form social media content. Long-form video comes up occasionally, so being capable of it is a bonus (not a requirement), but the bulk of the work will be short-form. You'll be working across a wide range of styles — from cinematic, commercial-style short films (think a highly polished 60-second cinematic piece) to simple, natural social content that isn't overly edited or "salesy." You'll also need to understand the difference between organic content and paid Meta ad video, since the editing approach for each is different.



You'll be coordinating closely with our team/assistant, so clear communication and the ability to follow instructions precisely are essential.



What You'll Do:

--Edit short-form social media videos (Reels, TikTok, etc.) — the majority of the workload

--Occasionally edit long-form video content (nice to have, not a core requirement)

--Edit cinematic-style short films/commercials as well as simple, natural, non-overedited social content and know when to use which style

--Understand and apply the differences between organic content editing and paid Meta ad video editing

--Stitch together footage from multiple takes/angles into one cohesive final video

--Build dynamic captions in DaVinci Resolve

--Apply solid sound design to every edit

--Create simple motion graphics/animations in After Effects when needed (not overly complex — clean, simple animation)

--Communicate proactively and coordinate closely with our team or assistant

--Follow instructions clearly and manage your time effectively to hit deadlines

--Handle a high volume of video work consistently



What We're Looking For (in order of importance)

--Color grading — this is the #1 skill we're hiring for. You must be genuinely strong at color grading.

--Pacing, storytelling, and narrative sense. Understanding how to structure a video for maximum engagement and impact is a major factor.

--Versatility in editing style. Able to switch between cinematic, story-driven commercial edits and simple, understated social content.

--Advanced DaVinci Resolve skills, particularly building dynamic captions. (Premiere Pro experience is not what we're looking for — this role is Resolve-based.)

--Strong understanding of sound design.

--Basic to intermediate After Effects skills for simple animations.

--Excellent communication — responsive, clear, and proactive.

--Strong time management — efficient, doesn't waste time, hits deadlines.

--Comfortable with high-volume work.

--A portfolio is required — we need to review your reel/work samples before any interview is scheduled.

--Must be willing to complete a trial video to demonstrate your quality of work before being brought on.



What We Offer:

AUD $1,400/month, full-time

Performance-based bonus opportunities

Long-term growth potential within the agency as we scale

How to Apply



Reply to this post with:

A link to your portfolio or demo reel (required — applications without a portfolio will not be considered)

A short introduction covering your experience with color grading, DaVinci Resolve (especially dynamic captions), and short-form content editing



We'll review portfolios first and reach out to schedule interviews with strong matches.



If you've read this far, respond with "Aethon" as the very first word of your application message.
