title: Video Editor
description:
About Us:



We help wedding filmmakers create better wedding films and grow the business side of their business.



We’re a lean, 7-figure online coaching company. You’ll work directly with our content team.





Role Overview:



Your mission is to turn raw uncut wedding behind-the scenes footage into polished, engaging YouTube videos and short-form content that grows our audience and makes the founder look great on camera.



You'll take footage, notes, and a style guide, and deliver clean edits on time, every time, without needing to be chased or reminded.



You will mainly be editing videos like on this channel:

 
 





One long video like this = one project.

This consists of 15-20 shorter scenes/videos that you will edit separately.





Responsibilities:



- Edit long-form YouTube videos (talking-head, teaching content, and behind-the-scenes wedding footage).



- Edit short-form vertical content (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) repurposed from long-form.



- Add captions, b-roll, music, sound design, lower-thirds, and light motion graphics following our style guide.



- Sync audio and video from multiple angles and sources when needed. Do a clean first-pass quality check (spelling, audio glitches, crooked shots, wrong logo) before submitting.



- Hit agreed deadlines and communicate early if anything will be late. Take revision notes and turn them around within 24 hours without losing the original vision.



- Keep files, projects, and folders organized and named correctly.





Requirements:



- Strong portfolio of YouTube and/or short-form content edits.



- Excellent editing skills in Premiere Pro.



- Great eye for pacing, hooks, retention, and clean, modern style.



- Excellent written and spoken English.



- Reliable, fast turnaround time, fast internet capable of downloading and uploading large video files.



- Comfortable following a style guide and strict file-naming and folder systems.



- Able to handle roughly one project per week and communicate consistently.



- Able to start ASAP.





Nice to Have (not required)



Experience with: wedding or event content, YouTube growth, motion graphics, AI tools, AI filmmaking, thumbnail design, After Effects, Canva or Photoshop, working with a content team or pipeline.





Do not apply if:



- You are an agency or plan to subcontract work to someone else.



- You can't reliably commit to a consistent flow of projects.



- You dislike following a style guide, checklists, or a set process.



- You are looking for a one-time gig (this is an ongoing, long-term role). 







Compensation & Growth:



- The average project pays around $300 to $500 USD and is expected to be completed within about one week.



- If you can deliver one project per week, that's roughly $1,200 to $2,000 USD per month of ongoing work.



- Top performers earn more over time as they take on more volume and more responsibility.



- Consistent, reliable editors get first pick of projects and long-term steady work.





How to Apply (follow these steps exactly)



- Join this Skool group below (This is where the training is hosted + we will reach out to you if you are selected):


 



- Answer the questions on the form when you join with your picture profile.



- Reply back to this post with your portfolio. If you write more than what is asked for above we will ignore your application. 



- Change the subject line to ‘I want to edit for [Founder’s name]’





If considered:



- $10 paid test project (2-3 hours)



- If hired, 1 paid trial project (fully paid)



- If we’re both happy, this becomes a long-term, full-time role starting at $300 per project x 4 ($1,200/month)



- After 90 days, and you are meeting deadlines and delivering quality work, we will increase your pay to $400-$500 per project ($1,600-$2,000 per month)

title: Google Ads & Facebook Ads Strategist
description:
About Aquasure Solutions



Aquasure Solutions provides whole-home water filtration and water treatment systems for Australian households. We are looking for an experienced Google Ads and Meta/Facebook Ads Strategist who can help us generate quality enquiries, improve campaign performance, and scale our digital advertising.



We are not simply looking for someone who can boost posts or set up basic campaigns. We need someone who understands strategy, lead generation, tracking, optimisation, testing and how to turn advertising spend into qualified leads.



What You'll Be Responsible For

- Plan and manage Google Ads campaigns, including Search, Display and remarketing where appropriate

- Manage
 and Instagram advertising through Meta Ads Manager

- Develop campaign strategies specifically focused on lead generation

- Conduct keyword, competitor and audience research

- Build and optimise campaign structures, audiences and targeting

- Write or recommend strong ad copy, headlines, hooks and CTAs

- Work with our marketing team on creative requirements

- Set up and monitor conversion tracking

- Review landing page performance and recommend improvements

- Monitor CPL, CTR, CPC, conversion rates and overall campaign performance

- Conduct A/B testing of creatives, audiences, offers and messaging

- Retarget website visitors and previous leads

- Identify underperforming campaigns quickly and make adjustments

- Provide clear weekly or monthly reporting

- Recommend opportunities to scale campaigns that are performing well



What We're Looking For

You should have proven experience managing both Google Ads and Meta Ads, preferably for:

- Home services

- Solar

- Plumbing

- Water filtration

- Trades

- Home improvement

- High-ticket products or services

- Local Australian businesses



Experience targeting Australian audiences is highly preferred.



You should also understand that our goal is not just to generate the cheapest possible lead. We want qualified homeowners who are genuinely interested in improving their home's water quality.



Skills Required

- Google Ads

- Meta/Facebook Ads Manager

- Google Analytics / GA4

- Google Tag Manager

- Conversion tracking

- Meta Pixel

- Lead generation

- Retargeting

- Keyword research

- Audience research

- Campaign optimisation

- A/B testing

Advertising analytics and reporting



Experience with landing page optimisation and marketing funnels would be a strong advantage.



The Person We're Looking For



We want someone who:

- Thinks strategically instead of just following instructions

- Can explain why a campaign is or isn't working

- Understands numbers and campaign data

- Is proactive about suggesting improvements

- Can manage advertising budgets responsibly

- Communicates clearly

- Is organised and reliable

- Is comfortable working independently

- Is willing to test different angles rather than relying on one campaign

- Can identify opportunities before being asked



We already have a marketing team producing content and creatives, so you will have support with graphics, videos and marketing materials. Your main responsibility will be making sure the advertising strategy, targeting and campaign performance are strong.



To Apply



Please send us:

- A short introduction about yourself

- How many years you have managed Google and Meta Ads

- Examples of campaigns you have managed

- Industries you have worked with

- Your experience generating leads for Australian businesses

- Screenshots or case studies showing results such as CPL, conversions or ROAS

- Your preferred working hours and availability

- Your expected hourly or monthly rate



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "AQUASURE ADS" so we know you have read the entire job post.



Please also answer this question:

If a Google or
 campaign is generating plenty of leads but the sales team says the leads are poor quality, what are the first three things you would investigate or change?



We are looking for someone who can potentially work with us long term as Aquasure Solutions continues to grow.

title: CS ACCOUNT MANAGER - $2,000 BASE P/M + BONUSES
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time, 40 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Static Ad Designer for DTC creative - Phase
description:
Static Ad Designer for Phase (Part-time / Freelance)



We're looking for a Static Ad Designer who lives and breathes DTC creative and can compete with the brands you already follow on Meta. Starting part-time / freelance, with clear room to scale hours as our creative volume grows.



Who we are



Phase is a fast-growing DTC brand redefining the digital welness category. We ship a physical app-blocker device that thousands of people use daily to reclaim their attention and get better focus.



- Featured across major DTC newsletters and press

- 4.9? across 2,000+ units sold in 19 countries

- Scaling our Meta creative engine hard, statics are our leading edge



The role



Not a graphic designer who occasionally does ads. Someone who knows exactly why brands like Eight Sleep's their device shots outperform 90% of competitors and can produce the same craft bar for Phase.



You'll own the visual side of our static pipeline: starting at ~8-10 statics per week (both 4:5 and 9:16), scaling up as we ramp. Working from strategic briefs and reference ads. Print-grade execution, no shortcuts, no cheap tells.



What you'll actually do



- Turn briefed concepts into finished statics in Figma ? export-ready

- Art-direct every ad: composition, hierarchy, whitespace, type, tension

- Work with our growing competitor/reference library (Atria), pull the right layout DNA per concept

- Iterate fast on winners, kill non-performers, feed craft learnings back into the system

- Collaborate on image-generation prompts (Higgsfield, Nano Banana Pro) when a swipe or new concept calls for it

- Own the craft bar, nothing ships that couldn't sit next to Oura or Eight Sleep in the feed



Who you are



Non-negotiables:



- Deep Figma expert. Auto-layout, variants, components, tokens, brand systems, not just "I've used it"

- Proven DTC static ad portfolio. Meta and/or TikTok, real ad accounts, real spend behind the work

- Worked at premium-brand tier. Statics for at least one high-craft DTC brand (agency, in-house, or freelance)

- Currently active in the market. You know what's converting right now, which concepts are trending, which brands set the bar this quarter

- Native art-direction sense. You see immediately why one static works and another doesn't, and can articulate it



Bonus signals:



- Mention the brands you made statics for with examples to get bonus points

- Familiar with the brands we benchmark against: Hears, Oura, Eight Sleep, reMarkable, WHOOP, Brick

- Comfort with reference-driven creative (swipe-and-elevate, not blank-slate)

- Experience with image generation tools (Higgsfield, Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney)

- Own opinions on why certain concepts convert (UvT vs Editorial vs Spec-sheet, etc.)



How we work



- Small focused team, direct communication, no politics

- Weekly performance data, you see what your work is doing in the ad account

- Autonomy over craft with a very high bar

- Feedback loop measured in days, not weeks

- Remote-first (HQ in Dubai, team distributed globally)



Structure



- Type: Freelance / part-time to start

- Hours: ~10-15 hours per week to begin (roughly 8-10 statics/week)

- Rate: €35-45/hr depending on portfolio + speed (or per-static rate if that fits your workflow better, let's discuss)

- Trajectory: Room to scale hours + rate as volume grows and we prove the match. Could evolve into a permanent seat.

- Location: Remote. Timezone overlap with GST helpful but not required.



How to apply



Send us:



1. 3-5 static ads YOU designed for DTC brands. Links or attachments. For each: brand name, platform (Meta/TikTok), and one line on what made it convert.



2. The brands you've worked on for static ads. Be specific: brand name, your role (agency / in-house / freelance), what you shipped (roughly how many statics), and over what period. Applications without this list won't be reviewed.



3. A 3-sentence take on the current DTC static market. Which concept type do you see winning right now, and why?



4. Your Figma workflow. How you set up files, use components, keep things systematic across many variants.



5. Rate/salary expectation + availability (hours/week you can commit).



Send to: 



We read every application. If your portfolio hits the bar you'll hear back within 5 working days with a paid test brief.



Why apply



You'll design for a brand that treats creative as the growth lever, not an afterthought. Real budgets, real data, real feedback. Your work goes live within days. You'll see it convert (or not) with your name on it. If you're the person we're looking for, this is the seat where your craft compounds fastest.



Phase | enterphase.app | Dubai

title: TikTok Shop Manager — Supplement Brand (EXPERIENCED ONLY!)
description:
TikTok Shop Manager — Supplement Brand



We are hiring an experienced **TikTok Shop Manager** to take full ownership of our TikTok Shop creator and affiliate program for a fast-growing supplement brand.



This is not an entry-level role. You must have direct experience managing TikTok Shop for a consumer brand and be able to provide proof of your results.



## Role Overview



You will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling our TikTok Shop program from A to Z, including creator sourcing, affiliate recruitment, outreach, product sampling, relationship management, content coordination, performance tracking, and revenue growth.



We are looking for someone proactive who can independently develop the strategy, execute it, analyze performance, and continuously improve the program without needing constant direction.



## Responsibilities



### Creator and Affiliate Recruitment



* Identify and recruit TikTok creators who are a strong fit for our products and target customers

* Conduct high-volume creator outreach through TikTok Shop,
, direct messages, agencies, and other sourcing platforms

* Build and maintain a structured pipeline of prospective, contacted, approved, active, and high-performing creators

* Negotiate affiliate commissions, flat fees, performance incentives, and content agreements when required

* Develop relationships with creators, affiliate managers, creator agencies, and TikTok Shop partners



### Product Sampling



* Manage the complete product sampling process from creator approval to delivery

* Evaluate sample requests based on creator quality, audience relevance, engagement, content history, and sales potential

* Coordinate product shipments with our fulfillment and operations teams

* Follow up with creators after delivery to ensure content is produced

* Track sample costs, content completion rates, creator activation rates, and revenue generated per sample

* Prevent excessive or low-quality sampling that does not generate content or sales



### Creator Management



* Create onboarding instructions, product education, selling points, content guidelines, and compliance requirements

* Maintain consistent communication with creators before and after they receive products

* Encourage creators to produce additional videos, test new hooks, and participate in promotions

* Identify top-performing affiliates and develop deeper partnerships with them

* Build incentive programs, contests, bonuses, and commission structures to increase creator output

* Reactivate creators who have stopped posting or generating sales



### Campaign and Content Strategy



* Develop creator campaigns around product launches, promotions, seasonal events, and TikTok Shop sales periods

* Provide creators with compliant content angles, hooks, talking points, offers, and creative direction

* Review creator content and identify the formats, messaging, and angles producing the strongest results

* Coordinate with our internal creative, marketing, and compliance teams

* Ensure creators avoid prohibited, misleading, or aggressive health claims

* Stay informed about TikTok Shop policies, supplement advertising requirements, platform changes, and affiliate trends



### TikTok Shop Management



* Manage affiliate settings, product listings, commissions, creator invitations, campaigns, and promotional tools

* Monitor account health, violations, product eligibility, fulfillment metrics, cancellations, returns, and customer feedback

* Identify and resolve issues affecting creator activation, product visibility, conversion rate, or account performance

* Coordinate with TikTok Shop support when necessary

* Maintain accurate reporting on sales, commissions, creator performance, samples, and campaign results



### Performance and Reporting



You will be accountable for measurable outcomes, including:



* Number of qualified creators contacted

* Creator response rate

* Number of creators recruited

* Number of samples approved and delivered

* Sample-to-content conversion rate

* Number of active creators posting each week

* Number of creator videos published

* Affiliate-generated revenue

* Revenue per creator

* Revenue per sample

* Gross merchandise value

* Content conversion rate

* Return on creator and affiliate spend

* Growth of the TikTok Shop channel



You will provide weekly reporting outlining performance, opportunities, bottlenecks, top creators, underperforming initiatives, and next steps.



## Required Experience



* Proven experience managing TikTok Shop for a consumer product, e-commerce, wellness, beauty, or supplement brand

* Direct experience with TikTok Shop affiliate management and creator outreach

* Strong understanding of creator sourcing, product sampling, affiliate commissions, and performance incentives

* Experience managing creators from initial outreach through content publication and sales generation

* Ability to analyze creator and campaign data and make decisions based on performance

* Strong written communication, negotiation, organization, and follow-up skills

* Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of the channel

* Familiarity with supplement compliance and prohibited health claims is highly preferred

* Existing relationships with TikTok creators, creator agencies, or affiliate networks are an advantage



## Proof of Results Is Mandatory



Applicants must provide actual proof of relevant TikTok Shop experience.



Your application must include:



* The brands or TikTok Shops you have managed

* The specific responsibilities you handled

* Screenshots or recordings of results, dashboards, campaigns, creator outreach, or affiliate performance

* Revenue or gross merchandise value generated

* Number of creators recruited or managed

* Sample-to-content conversion rates, when available

* Examples of creators or campaigns you helped scale

* A clear explanation of the results you personally contributed to



Confidential information may be blurred, but the proof must clearly demonstrate legitimate TikTok Shop experience.



**Applicants who do not provide proof of actual experience and results will be automatically denied.**



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should be able to:



* Establish an organized creator outreach and sampling system

* Build a consistent pipeline of qualified creators

* Increase the number of active affiliates publishing content

* Improve the percentage of sampled creators who produce content

* Identify and scale high-performing creators and content angles

* Generate measurable and growing TikTok Shop revenue

* Provide clear reporting and take ownership of all creator-related operations



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. A summary of your TikTok Shop experience

2. The brands or product categories you have worked with

3. Proof of your actual results

4. Your strongest TikTok Shop case study

5. The number of creators you have recruited or managed

6. Your availability and expected compensation

7. A brief explanation of how you would build and scale a TikTok Shop affiliate program for a supplement brand



Applications containing generic responses, AI-generated answers without supporting proof, or no evidence of TikTok Shop results will not be considered.

title: Airbnb Operations Lead
description:
We are a premier short-term rental management company that excels at delivering a luxury-grade experience for our guests. Because we hold our operations to hotel-standard cleanliness and rapid, high-touch communication, we are looking for a highly proactive, meticulous, and persistent Virtual Assistant to join our team.



In this role, you aren’t just answering messages; you are the operational heartbeat of our properties. We do not micro-manage. Instead, we empower diligent professionals who take total ownership of their shifts. Our ideal candidate possesses an "owner's mindset" and is relentlessly persistent - you do not let tasks slide, and you proactively follow up on every open item until it is 100% resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Rapid, High-Standard Responses: Manage the guest inbox across all platforms (Airbnb, Vrbo, Direct Booking), responding to inquiries within 5 minutes with a warm, professional, and on-brand tone.



Anticipatory Guest Support: Don't just answer questions - anticipate what the guest will need next. (e.g., If a guest asks about check-in, proactively provide parking details, local recommendations, and check-in steps before they have to ask).



Persistent Problem Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for guest issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, troubleshooting smart home tech). Own the problem from start to finish. If a local contact doesn't respond immediately, you don't wait—you follow up persistently until the guest's issue is fully resolved and confirmed.



Review Maximization & Management: Actively monitor guest sentiment mid-stay to resolve minor issues early. Respond to post-stay reviews and diligently build cases to dispute unfair reviews according to platform policies.



Flawless Turnover Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule cleaning crews daily. Double-check calendar synchronizations across all platforms to guarantee zero missed cleanings.



Quality Control Oversight: Review turnover photos and checklists submitted by cleaners with an eagle eye. Diligently flag and address any missed details (e.g., uneven bed tucks, low inventory, or missed dust) before the next guest arrives.



Relentless Maintenance Coordination: Proactively coordinate with local handymen and providers. Track ongoing maintenance tickets and persistently follow up with vendors until you have physical or photographic proof that the job is completed to our standards.



Aggressive Claims Management: Diligently document and track any guest damages. Gather photographic evidence, cleaner statements, and repair estimates. Follow up relentlessly on pending AirCover or insurance claims until reimbursement is fully approved and paid.



Listing Maintenance: Assist with administrative tasks such as updating calendars, managing listings, and refreshing local guidebooks to keep our digital presence competitive.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Airbnb/short-term rental property management and hospitality is strictly required.



Proactive & Persistent Follow-Through: You have a natural drive to close open loops. You do not let tasks sit on "pending" without active, continuous follow-up. You are comfortably persistent when dealing with unresponsive guests, cleaners, vendors, or support platforms.



Extreme Attention to Detail: You are someone who spots a typo from a mile away and notices when a cleaner's photo doesn’t match our standard property layout.



Superb Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English skills. You can write polished, empathetic, and grammatically perfect messages under pressure, while still maintaining a firm and professional stance when chasing down resolutions.



Software Proficiency: Highly comfortable navigating Property Management Systems (PMS) like Guesty or Hospitable, alongside turnover platforms (e.g., Breezeway) and dynamic pricing tools.



Workspace & Schedule: A reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup power/internet solution, a quiet workspace, and the ability to work shifts aligned with US time zones.



Why Join Us?



Professional Growth: We value talent and reward proactive, high-performing team members who drive results with increased responsibility, growth opportunities, and performance-based bonuses.



Collaborative Environment: We provide documented SOPs and training, but we welcome your ideas on how to optimize and improve them.



Empowered Autonomy: We trust you to do your job. If you are diligent, persistent, and proactive, you will find a highly supportive, collaborative, and rewarding environment here.



How to Apply (Our First Attention-to-Detail & Follow-Through Test)



To prove you are the diligent and persistent professional we are looking for, please reply with:



A copy of your resume highlighting your experience managing short-term rentals.

The name of the Property Management Software (PMS) you are most comfortable using.

An example of a time you had to be highly persistent to resolve a difficult property management or guest issue.



Include the word "Detail-Oriented" in the 1st sentence of your response to us (Note: Applications that do not follow these two instructions precisely will be automatically disqualified).

Your primary role will be to transform raw footage into polished short- and long-form demo videos that effectively showcase content for clients. You should have a strong understanding of graphic animation, rotoscoping techniques, and creative storytelling to produce videos that stand out.



Please share your three best demo or highlight videos when applying. Attention to detail and a proactive approach to creative challenges are essential for this role.



Please review these example: 



Key Responsibilities:

- Review raw video footage and identify segments that best convey the intended message.

- Edit and assemble footage into polished demo videos optimized for clarity and engagement.

- Enhance videos with music, sound effects, and audio mixing that complement the visuals.

- Apply basic color grading and correction for consistent and professional results.

- Add motion graphics, overlays, captions, and other visual effects to enhance storytelling.

- Work closely with project leads to ensure videos align with the client’s vision and requirements.

- Manage multiple demo projects, ensuring timely delivery without compromising quality.

- Review and revise edits based on feedback to produce the final deliverable.

- Stay updated with demo video trends, editing tools, and techniques.



Requirements

- Proven experience in editing demo, highlight, or promotional videos with a portfolio showcasing your work.

- Proficiency with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, After Effects, or similar tools.

- A creative eye for detail and an ability to tell a story through visuals.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to meet deadlines while managing multiple projects.

- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a remote team.

- Flexibility to adapt to client needs and feedback.



What We Offer

- A collaborative remote working environment with constructive feedback.

- Access to professional editing tools and resources such as Submagic and Envato Elements.

- Opportunities for learning and skill development.

- Regular performance feedback to help you improve and grow.

title: Airbnb Operations Lead
description:
We are a premier short-term rental management company that excels at delivering a luxury-grade experience for our guests. Because we hold our operations to hotel-standard cleanliness and rapid, high-touch communication, we are looking for a highly proactive, meticulous, and persistent Virtual Assistant to join our team.



In this role, you aren’t just answering messages; you are the operational heartbeat of our properties. We do not micro-manage. Instead, we empower diligent professionals who take total ownership of their shifts. Our ideal candidate possesses an "owner's mindset" and is relentlessly persistent - you do not let tasks slide, and you proactively follow up on every open item until it is 100% resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Rapid, High-Standard Responses: Manage the guest inbox across all platforms (Airbnb, Vrbo, Direct Booking), responding to inquiries within 5 minutes with a warm, professional, and on-brand tone.



Anticipatory Guest Support: Don't just answer questions - anticipate what the guest will need next. (e.g., If a guest asks about check-in, proactively provide parking details, local recommendations, and check-in steps before they have to ask).



Persistent Problem Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for guest issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, troubleshooting smart home tech). Own the problem from start to finish. If a local contact doesn't respond immediately, you don't wait—you follow up persistently until the guest's issue is fully resolved and confirmed.



Review Maximization & Management: Actively monitor guest sentiment mid-stay to resolve minor issues early. Respond to post-stay reviews and diligently build cases to dispute unfair reviews according to platform policies.



Flawless Turnover Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule cleaning crews daily. Double-check calendar synchronizations across all platforms to guarantee zero missed cleanings.



Quality Control Oversight: Review turnover photos and checklists submitted by cleaners with an eagle eye. Diligently flag and address any missed details (e.g., uneven bed tucks, low inventory, or missed dust) before the next guest arrives.



Relentless Maintenance Coordination: Proactively coordinate with local handymen and providers. Track ongoing maintenance tickets and persistently follow up with vendors until you have physical or photographic proof that the job is completed to our standards.



Aggressive Claims Management: Diligently document and track any guest damages. Gather photographic evidence, cleaner statements, and repair estimates. Follow up relentlessly on pending AirCover or insurance claims until reimbursement is fully approved and paid.



Listing Maintenance: Assist with administrative tasks such as updating calendars, managing listings, and refreshing local guidebooks to keep our digital presence competitive.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Airbnb/short-term rental property management and hospitality is strictly required.



Proactive & Persistent Follow-Through: You have a natural drive to close open loops. You do not let tasks sit on "pending" without active, continuous follow-up. You are comfortably persistent when dealing with unresponsive guests, cleaners, vendors, or support platforms.



Extreme Attention to Detail: You are someone who spots a typo from a mile away and notices when a cleaner's photo doesn’t match our standard property layout.



Superb Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English skills. You can write polished, empathetic, and grammatically perfect messages under pressure, while still maintaining a firm and professional stance when chasing down resolutions.



Software Proficiency: Highly comfortable navigating Property Management Systems (PMS) like Guesty or Hospitable, alongside turnover platforms (e.g., Breezeway) and dynamic pricing tools.



Workspace & Schedule: A reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup power/internet solution, a quiet workspace, and the ability to work shifts aligned with US time zones.



Why Join Us?



Professional Growth: We value talent and reward proactive, high-performing team members who drive results with increased responsibility, growth opportunities, and performance-based bonuses.



Collaborative Environment: We provide documented SOPs and training, but we welcome your ideas on how to optimize and improve them.



Empowered Autonomy: We trust you to do your job. If you are diligent, persistent, and proactive, you will find a highly supportive, collaborative, and rewarding environment here.



How to Apply (Our First Attention-to-Detail & Follow-Through Test)



To prove you are the diligent and persistent professional we are looking for, please reply with:



A copy of your resume highlighting your experience managing short-term rentals.

The name of the Property Management Software (PMS) you are most comfortable using.

An example of a time you had to be highly persistent to resolve a difficult property management or guest issue.



Include the word "Detail-Oriented" in the 1st sentence of your response to us (Note: Applications that do not follow these two instructions precisely will be automatically disqualified).

title: Experienced Real Estate Cold Caller (Wholesaling)
description:
Experienced Real Estate Cold Caller (Wholesaling)



We are a Virginia-based real estate investment company looking for an experienced cold caller who has worked specifically with off-market residential property owners.



Requirements:



* Minimum 2 years of experience calling homeowners for real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, or investor lead generation

* Must be comfortable calling property owners and asking if they would consider a cash offer for their property

* Experienced in gathering the 4 key seller pillars:

Property Condition

Motivation

Price/Expected Offer

Timeline

* Ability to build rapport, overcome objections, and identify motivated sellers

* Experience providing a soft offer or price range is a plus

* Fluent English with clear pronunciation and strong communication skills

* Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and quiet work environment

* Honest, dependable, hardworking, and coachable



Daily Responsibilities:



* Make 200–300 outbound calls per day

* Speak with homeowners and qualify seller leads

* Collect accurate notes and seller information

* Set 2–3 qualified appointments per day for our acquisitions team

* Update CRM and follow company procedures



Compensation & Schedule:



* Monday–Friday

* 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time (US)

* $4–$5 per hour (based on experience)

* $150 bonus for every deal that closes from your lead



How to Apply:



 the following to: 



1. Your resume

2. A 1–3 minute audio recording introducing yourself and describing your real estate cold-calling experience



Applications without BOTH a resume and audio recording will not be considered.



In your
 subject line, please include:

"Experienced RE Cold Caller - [Your Name]"
